sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性遗体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请查看您应用内或我们网站上的本集节目说明。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的内容涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: In the winter of 1996, Stacey Gaylord stood by the water's edge at the Sydney Olympic Park Aquatic Centre.
sentences.zh: 1996年冬天，斯泰西·盖洛德站在悉尼奥林匹克公园水上运动中心的水边。

sentences.en: As a member of the Balmain women's water polo team, it was a familiar scene for Stacey as she and her teammates milled around the poolside in their swimsuits and bathing caps,
sentences.zh: 作为巴尔曼女子水球队的一员，这对斯泰西来说是个熟悉的场景，她和队友们穿着泳衣、戴着泳帽在池边走动，

sentences.en: waiting for their training session to begin.
sentences.zh: 等待训练开始。

sentences.en: When it came time to enter the water,
sentences.zh: 当轮到下水时，

sentences.en: Stacey glanced over and noticed that her friend and teammate, 21-year-old Kelly Lane, was sitting on the edge of the pool with a towel wrapped tightly under her arMs.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西瞥了一眼，注意到她21岁的朋友兼队友凯莉·莱恩正坐在池边，一条毛巾紧紧裹在腋下。

sentences.en: She held it there until the very last moment, before dropping it to one side and discreetly slipping into the water.
sentences.zh: 她一直抓着毛巾直到最后一刻，才将其扔到一边，悄悄溜进水里。

sentences.en: Stacey found this unusual.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西觉得这很不寻常。

sentences.en: Kelly was an accomplished athlete who'd been competing in water sports all her life.
sentences.zh: 凯莉是一位出色的运动员，一生都在参加水上运动。

sentences.en: She was no stranger to wearing her swimsuit in public and until relatively recently, she typically walked around confidently in her bathers before diving straight into the pool.
sentences.zh: 她在公共场合穿泳衣早已习以为常，直到最近，她通常都是自信地穿着泳装走来走去，然后直接跳进泳池。

sentences.en: Stacey had also noticed that Kelly had taken into wearing tracksuits over her swimsuit, no matter the weather.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西还注意到，无论天气如何，凯莉开始在泳衣外面穿上运动服。

sentences.en: Stacey had her suspicions as to why.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西对原因产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: She put her goggles on and ducked under the water to catch a glimpse of Kelly's body.
sentences.zh: 她戴上护目镜，潜入水中，想看一眼凯莉的身体。

sentences.en: It was just as she suspected.
sentences.zh: 正如她所料。

sentences.en: Kelly Lane was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 凯莉·莱恩怀孕了。

sentences.en: This was significant for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 这在几个方面都很重要。

sentences.en: For starters, the two were close friends, and Kelly had never once mentioned that she was expecting a baby.
sentences.zh: 首先，两人是好朋友，而凯莉从未提过她怀孕的事。

sentences.en: Secondly, water polo is a physically demanding contact sport in which injuries are commonplace, not the type of activity one would expect to see a heavily pregnant woman
sentences.zh: 其次，水球是一项身体对抗激烈的运动，受伤是常有的事，这并不是人们期望看到一位身怀六甲的孕妇

sentences.en: participating in.
sentences.zh: 参与的活动。

sentences.en: Stacey knew Kelly's long-term boyfriend, rugby player Duncan Gillies, and she assumed the couple had decided to keep the pregnancy quiet.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西认识凯莉的长期男友、橄榄球运动员邓肯·吉利斯，她以为这对情侣决定对怀孕一事保密。

sentences.en: Respecting their privacy, she said nothing to Kelly about it.
sentences.zh: 出于对他们隐私的尊重，她没有对凯莉提起这件事。

sentences.en: Stacey didn't see Kelly play another game after that.
sentences.zh: 此后，斯泰西再没见过凯莉参加比赛。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, she noticed Kelly was no longer pregnant.
sentences.zh: 几周后，她发现凯莉不再怀孕了。

sentences.en: It occurred to her that Kelly must have given birth, but she didn't stop to think about what had happened to the baby.
sentences.zh: 她意识到凯莉一定已经生了孩子，但她并没有停下来去想那个孩子发生了什么。

sentences.en: Just short of three years later, on Wednesday, June 2, 1999, Anglicare Adoption Service's social worker, Virginia Fung, arrived at Ryde Hospital in northern Sydney
sentences.zh: 不到三年后，即1999年6月2日星期三，Anglicare收养服务机构的社会工作者弗吉尼亚·冯抵达了悉尼北部的莱德医院。

sentences.en: A young patient had called the agency the previous day with a somewhat unusual case
sentences.zh: 一位年轻的病人前一天致电该机构，提出了一个有些不同寻常的案例。

sentences.en: She had just given birth and wanted to place her baby for adoption
sentences.zh: 她刚刚分娩，想要将孩子送去收养。

sentences.en: Virginia was a little taken aback It was incredibly rare for a new mother to make such a request
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚感到有些惊讶，因为新妈妈提出这种要求极其罕见。

sentences.en: The adoption process typically began much earlier in the pregnancy With appropriate arrangements already in place by the time the baby was born
sentences.zh: 收养程序通常在怀孕早期就开始，在孩子出生时就已经做好了相应的安排。

sentences.en: Virginia was introduced to the patient, 24-year-old Kelly Lane And her two-day-old son, Jacob, not his real name
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚见到了这位病人，24岁的凯莉·莱恩，以及她出生两天的儿子雅各布（化名）。

sentences.en: Kelly explained that she'd been living in London for the past year with her boyfriend Duncan Gillies, a professional rugby player who was still in the UK.
sentences.zh: 凯莉解释说，过去一年她一直和男友邓肯·吉利斯住在伦敦，邓肯是一名职业橄榄球运动员，目前仍留在英国。

sentences.en: The couple had recently broken up and she didn't feel able to care for a child.
sentences.zh: 两人最近分手了，她觉得自己无法照顾孩子。

sentences.en: Not only was she due back in London for work in a few weeks' time, her parents weren't happy about the pregnancy and couldn't offer any help.
sentences.zh: 她不仅几周后就要回伦敦工作，而且她的父母对她怀孕并不高兴，也无法提供任何帮助。

sentences.en: Duncan wasn't prepared to be a parent either, so they'd agreed their best option was to have the baby adopted.
sentences.zh: 邓肯也没准备好当父亲，所以他们商定最好的选择是让孩子被收养。

sentences.en: Virginia was a little concerned.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚有些担忧。

sentences.en: Kelly appeared to be a doting mother to Jacob.
sentences.zh: 凯莉看起来是一位疼爱雅各布的母亲。

sentences.en: Virginia worried she'd made a rash decision and might change her mind in a few days' time.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚担心她做出了草率的决定，几天后可能会改变主意。

sentences.en: She began making arrangements to place Jacob into short-term foster care, while Kelly was discharged from hospital to think about her options.
sentences.zh: 她开始安排将雅各布送入短期寄养家庭，同时凯莉出院去考虑她的选择。

sentences.en: The following day, a midwife arrived at the address Kelly had provided to administer routine postnatal care
sentences.zh: 第二天，一名助产士来到凯莉提供的地址进行常规产后护理。

sentences.en: A confused man answered the door He said Kelly Lane hadn't lived at the property for a year and a half
sentences.zh: 一位困惑的男子开了门，他说凯莉·莱恩已经一年半没住在这里了。

sentences.en: Virginia Fung dialed the landline Kelly had supplied, only to find that it was a wrong number
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚·冯拨打了凯莉提供的座机号码，却发现是个空号。

sentences.en: She called Kelly's mobile, but it went straight to voicemail
sentences.zh: 她拨打了凯莉的手机，但直接转入了语音信箱。

sentences.en: When Kelly arrived for a pre-arranged meeting with Virginia a few days later and was told about the midwife's failed visit, Kelly insisted it was the right address.
sentences.zh: 几天后，当凯莉来参加与弗吉尼亚预定的会面并被告知助产士上门失败时，凯莉坚称地址是正确的。

sentences.en: She was staying there with Franz and the man who answered the door just hadn't been aware of this fact.
sentences.zh: 她一直和弗朗茨住在那儿，而开门的那个男人只是不知道这个事实。

sentences.en: The foster care agreement Kelly entered into was only valid for one month, during which she was expected to attend access visits with baby Jacob.
sentences.zh: 凯莉签署的寄养协议有效期仅为一个月，在此期间她需要参加对雅各布的探视。

sentences.en: Once the month was over, she'd have the option of officially signing the adoption papers.
sentences.zh: 一个月期满后，她将可以选择正式签署收养文件。

sentences.en: But as the weeks passed by, Virginia found it increasingly difficult to get in touch with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 但随着几周过去，弗吉尼亚发现越来越难联系到凯莉。

sentences.en: Her mobile was almost always switched off, and she only returned
sentences.zh: 她的手机几乎总是关机，而且她只在

sentences.en: Virginia's calls out of hours, typically to cancel meetings at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 工作时间之外回拨弗吉尼亚的电话，通常是为了在最后一刻取消会面。

sentences.en: Kelly had various explanations for her lack of availability.
sentences.zh: 凯莉对自己的失联有各种各样的解释。

sentences.en: She said she had to travel to Canberra to sort out some issues with her UK visa and that her ex-partner Duncan had frozen their joint bank
sentences.zh: 她说她必须去堪培拉处理英国签证的一些问题，而且她的前任邓肯冻结了他们的联名银行

sentences.en: account and she needed to see a solicitor to sort it out.
sentences.zh: 账户，她需要找律师来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Virginia was a consummate professional who treated all the mothers she worked with compassionately.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚是一位非常专业的从业者，她总是充满同情心地对待所有她服务的母亲。

sentences.en: But she couldn't help but feel that Kelly Lane wasn't being completely honeSt. Virginia wondered whether Kelly was purposely
sentences.zh: 但她不禁觉得凯莉·莱恩并没有完全诚实。弗吉尼亚怀疑凯莉是否在故意

sentences.en: stalling the adoption process because she was reluctant about moving forward.
sentences.zh: 拖延收养程序，因为她不愿继续推进。

sentences.en: During the few visits she'd had with Jacob, she'd been very loving towards him, bringing him presents and shedding tears over the agonising decision she faced.
sentences.zh: 在几次探视雅各布的过程中，她对他表现得非常有爱心，给他带礼物，并为她所面临的痛苦抉择流泪。

sentences.en: As the one-month deadline approached, Kelly finally agreed to meet with Virginia to sign the adoption papers.
sentences.zh: 随着一个月期限临近，凯莉终于同意与弗吉尼亚会面签署收养文件。

sentences.en: But when the day came, she failed to show.
sentences.zh: 但到了那天，她却没出现。

sentences.en: Virginia tried the number of a friend Kelly said could offer her support.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚尝试了凯莉说能为她提供支持的一位朋友的号码。

sentences.en: That too was false.
sentences.zh: 那个号码也是假的。

sentences.en: The foster care agreement expired, leaving Virginia with no choice but to hand the case to the New South Wales Department of
sentences.zh: 寄养协议到期，弗吉尼亚别无选择，只能将案件移交给新南威尔士州

sentences.en: Community Services, or DOCS.
sentences.zh: 社区服务部（DOCS）。

sentences.en: In the eyes of the law, Kelly had technically abandoned her baby boy.
sentences.zh: 在法律眼中，凯莉在技术上已经遗弃了她的男婴。

sentences.en: Virginia had also been unsuccessfully trying to make contact with the Jacobs' father,
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚也一直试图联系雅各布的父亲，

sentences.en: Kelly's ex, Duncan Gillies.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的前任邓肯·吉利斯，但均未成功。

sentences.en: Kelly kept saying she'd give Virginia Duncan's UK phone number, but she'd failed to do so.
sentences.zh: 凯莉一直说她会给弗吉尼亚邓肯的英国电话号码，但她一直没给。

sentences.en: Not sure what else to do, Virginia wrote a letter to Duncan's former rugby club in Sydney in the hopes they could forward it on to him.
sentences.zh: 由于不知道还能做什么，弗吉尼亚给邓肯在悉尼的前橄榄球俱乐部写了一封信，希望他们能转交给他。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Duncan called
sentences.zh: 不久后，邓肯给

sentences.en: Virginia in a state of shock.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚打了电话，语气非常震惊。

sentences.en: As far as he was concerned, there was no way he could be Jacob's father.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，他绝不可能是雅各布的父亲。

sentences.en: While he and Kelly had been a couple for several years during their early 20s,
sentences.zh: 虽然他和凯莉在20岁出头时曾交往过几年，

sentences.en: Duncan said their relationship had ended about 18 months prior and they hadn't had contact since.
sentences.zh: 但邓肯说他们的关系在约18个月前就结束了，此后他们再无联系。

sentences.en: Duncan had moved to London for a period of time but as far as he knew Kelly still lived in Sydney and always had.
sentences.zh: 邓肯曾搬到伦敦住过一段时间，但他所知的是凯莉一直住在悉尼，从未离开。

sentences.en: Virginia confronted Kelly with this information.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚用这些信息与凯莉对质。

sentences.en: Kelly broke down admitting she made the story up because she thought it would be better if Jacob grew up thinking he'd been the result of a loving long-term relationship.
sentences.zh: 凯莉崩溃了，承认她编造了这个故事，因为她认为如果雅各布在成长过程中以为自己是一段长期恋爱关系的结晶，会更好一些。

sentences.en: Kelly said that Jacob's father was actually a man named Aaron Williams, an Aussie she'd met while living in London.
sentences.zh: 凯莉说雅各布的父亲实际上是一个叫亚伦·威廉姆斯的男人，是她在伦敦生活时认识的澳大利亚人。

sentences.en: Kelly told Virginia that
sentences.zh: 凯莉告诉弗吉尼亚，

sentences.en: Aaron knew about the pregnancy and had consented to the adoption.
sentences.zh: 亚伦知道怀孕的事，并同意了收养。

sentences.en: She signed an affidavit confirming this, but was unable to provide any contact details for Aaron.
sentences.zh: 她签署了一份宣誓书证实了这一点，但无法提供亚伦的任何联系方式。

sentences.en: All she knew was that he had a university degree and worked at Barclays Bank in London.
sentences.zh: 她只知道他有大学学位，在伦敦的巴克莱银行工作。

sentences.en: Virginia contacted the Australian and
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚联系了巴克莱银行的澳大利亚和

sentences.en: UK officers of Barclays Bank, only to find that no one named Aaron Williams was employed there.
sentences.zh: 英国办事处，结果发现那里并没有叫亚伦·威廉姆斯的人工作。

sentences.en: This was unsurprising, given Virginia already knew that Kelly had never lived in London.
sentences.zh: 这并不令人意外，因为弗吉尼亚已经知道凯莉从未在伦敦住过。

sentences.en: She was starting to have some serious concerns about Kelly's mental health and whether she was even fit to give legal consent to Jacob's adoption.
sentences.zh: 她开始对凯莉的心理健康状况产生严重担忧，甚至怀疑她是否具备为雅各布的收养提供法律同意的能力。

sentences.en: In addition to giving evasive answers, being uncontactable and dragging out the adoption process,
sentences.zh: 除了回答闪烁其词、无法联系和拖延收养程序外，

sentences.en: Kelly had told another lie that Virginia simply couldn't make sense of.
sentences.zh: 凯莉还说了另一个弗吉尼亚完全无法理解的谎言。

sentences.en: When Kelly presented at Wright Hospital to give birth to Jacob, their records showed that she'd previously visited three years earlier, in September 1996.
sentences.zh: 当凯莉在莱德医院分娩雅各布时，他们的记录显示她三年前的1996年9月曾来过。

sentences.en: Kelly had been heavily pregnant at the time and asked to be induced.
sentences.zh: 当时凯莉已怀有身孕，并要求引产。

sentences.en: Staff declined to do so because she hadn't quite reached full term But their records showed that she went on to have the child across town at Auburn Hospital
sentences.zh: 工作人员拒绝了，因为她还没到足月。但记录显示，她后来在城另一头的奥本医院生下了孩子。

sentences.en: During Jacob's birth in 1999, Ride Hospital staff questioned Kelly about this previous birth
sentences.zh: 在1999年雅各布出生期间，莱德医院的工作人员曾就这次之前的分娩询问过凯莉。

sentences.en: Kelly said she'd had a daughter whom she'd breastfed for six months And who had travelled with her from London to Sydney
sentences.zh: 凯莉说她曾有一个女儿，她母乳喂养了六个月，并且和她一起从伦敦旅行到了悉尼。

sentences.en: But when Virginia Fung asked Kelly if she had any other children, she gave an entirely different answer
sentences.zh: 但当弗吉尼亚·冯问凯莉是否还有其他孩子时，她给出了完全不同的回答。

sentences.en: She said Jacob was her first and only child
sentences.zh: 她说雅各布是她的第一个也是唯一的孩子。

sentences.en: The doc's social worker assigned to Kelly's case, John Barovnik, obtained Kelly's medical records
sentences.zh: 负责凯莉案件的DOCS社会工作者约翰·巴罗夫尼克获取了凯莉的医疗记录。

sentences.en: If Jacob had a sister, it was only fair that it went on his records so he could contact her in the future if he so desired
sentences.zh: 如果雅各布有一个姐姐，那么记录在案对他来说是公平的，这样他将来如果想联系她就可以联系。

sentences.en: John confirmed that Kelly had indeed given birth to a baby girl named Tegan in September of 1996
sentences.zh: 约翰证实，凯莉确实在1996年9月生下了一个名叫泰根的女婴。

sentences.en: But she'd also given birth to another girl in March 1995 called Kayla Not her real name
sentences.zh: 但她还在1995年3月生下了另一个名叫凯拉（化名）的女孩。

sentences.en: The hospital records of Jacob, Tegan and Kayla each listed Duncan Gillies as the father
sentences.zh: 雅各布、泰根和凯拉的医院记录中，父亲一栏都列着邓肯·吉利斯。

sentences.en: From the records, it was clear that Kayla had been legally adopted to a loving family But John could find no record of what happened to Tegan
sentences.zh: 从记录中可以清楚地看出，凯拉已被合法收养给了一个充满爱的家庭，但约翰找不到关于泰根下落的任何记录。

sentences.en: John called Kelly and asked her if she'd previously given birth
sentences.zh: 约翰打电话给凯莉，问她以前是否生过孩子。

sentences.en: She admitted that she'd placed Kayla for adoption in 1995 But denied ever being pregnant in 1996 or visiting Ryde Hospital at that time
sentences.zh: 她承认她在1995年将凯拉送去收养，但否认1996年怀孕或在那时去过莱德医院。

sentences.en: John knew Kelly was lying He had her records in front of him and could see it for himself
sentences.zh: 约翰知道凯莉在撒谎。他面前就有她的记录，他自己看得一清二楚。

sentences.en: But if Kelly didn't have Tegan and she hadn't been formally adopted Then where was she?
sentences.zh: 但如果凯莉没有泰根，而她也没有被正式收养，那她去哪儿了？

sentences.en: John Barovnik told Kelly that he had no choice but to contact the police and inform them of the matter
sentences.zh: 约翰·巴罗夫尼克告诉凯莉，他别无选择，只能联系警方并告知他们此事。

sentences.en: Kelly wrote John a letter explaining that she intended to discuss the situation with Virginia Fung She asked that John refrain from making any inquiries in the meantime, explaining
sentences.zh: 凯莉给约翰写了一封信，解释说她打算与弗吉尼亚·冯讨论这种情况。她请求约翰在此期间不要进行任何调查，并解释道：

sentences.en: Many people have been involved by name who actually have no knowledge of what has occurred and therefore are useless in your inquiries
sentences.zh: 许多人因为名字被牵扯进来，但他们实际上对发生的事情一无所知，因此在你的调查中毫无用处。

sentences.en: Please do not contact them before giving me prior notice as they will be completely unaware of what you are talking about.
sentences.zh: 请在通知我之前不要联系他们，因为他们完全不知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: A few days later, a fax from Kelly arrived at Virginia's office, which read,
sentences.zh: 几天后，弗吉尼亚的办公室收到了一份来自凯莉的传真，上面写着：

sentences.en: Dear Virginia,
sentences.zh: 亲爱的弗吉尼亚：

sentences.en: Firstly, thank you for all of your time, your patience and your understanding, even though I have not been entirely honest with you.
sentences.zh: 首先，感谢你付出的所有时间、耐心和理解，尽管我对你并不完全诚实。

sentences.en: I'm glad now that I can stop telling half-truths and lies and perhaps move on in my life.
sentences.zh: 我现在很高兴能停止说半真半假的话和谎言，也许能继续我的生活。

sentences.en: It must be very hard for you to understand what has been going on and why I have done the things I've done and I'm not sure I can give you all the answers
sentences.zh: 你一定很难理解发生了什么，以及我为什么要这样做，我不确定我能给你所有的答案。

sentences.en: Over all of these weeks my main concern was Jacob and making sure that he was safe and happy and that you would find him a loving and secure home
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，我最关心的是雅各布，确保他安全快乐，并确保你能为他找到一个充满爱和安全的家。

sentences.en: So where do I start?
sentences.zh: 那么我从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: I'm not sure
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: My life for the last six years has been a nightmare
sentences.zh: 过去六年来，我的生活一直是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: Many people, including my family, have disowned me, and looking at the situation, I guess it's not hard to figure out why.
sentences.zh: 许多人，包括我的家人，都与我断绝了关系，看看现在的情况，我想不难理解为什么。

sentences.en: There were three children.
sentences.zh: 有三个孩子。

sentences.en: Obviously, I can't lie anymore as the paperwork is there.
sentences.zh: 显然，我不能再撒谎了，因为文件就在那里。

sentences.en: The middle child lives with a family in Perth, although I have not had contact with them for a long time.
sentences.zh: 中间的孩子和珀斯的一个家庭住在一起，虽然我已经很久没有和他们联系了。

sentences.en: Kelly went on to explain that no one in her life knew the full story and she wanted to keep it that way.
sentences.zh: 凯莉接着解释说，她生命中没有人知道全部真相，她想保持现状。

sentences.en: She said people close to her had dropped her from their lives when they found out she was going to place her babies up for adoption and she was doing her
sentences.zh: 她说，当她身边的人发现她要把孩子送去收养时，他们就疏远了她，她正在尽

sentences.en: best to settle down and find some sort of stability.
sentences.zh: 最大努力安定下来，寻找某种稳定。

sentences.en: Kelly said her parents lived in London and she hoped to rebuild a relationship with them when visiting in a few weeks' time.
sentences.zh: 凯莉说她的父母住在伦敦，她希望几周后去探望时能重建与他们的关系。

sentences.en: I hurt mentally, emotionally and physically every day, Kelly wrote.
sentences.zh: “我每天在精神上、情感上和身体上都感到痛苦，”凯莉写道。

sentences.en: I have to live with this for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 我余生都必须带着这个生活。

sentences.en: I constantly feel sick.
sentences.zh: 我一直感到恶心。

sentences.en: I'm always on edge.
sentences.zh: 我总是处于紧张状态。

sentences.en: I guess I knew all along that it would all come out in the open and in some ways I'm glad it has.
sentences.zh: 我想我一直都知道这一切终会大白于天下，在某种程度上，我很高兴它发生了。

sentences.en: While Kelly asked Virginia to respect her need for discretion, she gave Virginia permission to share this information with the docks worker, John Borovnik.
sentences.zh: 虽然凯莉要求弗吉尼亚尊重她对保密的需求，但她允许弗吉尼亚与DOCS的工作人员约翰·巴罗夫尼克分享这些信息。

sentences.en: But Kelly's explanation did little to ease John's concerns about the situation.
sentences.zh: 但凯莉的解释并没有减轻约翰对这种情况的担忧。

sentences.en: Still perplexed as to why she lied about Teagan's existence and baffled by the explanation that she'd been sent to live with a family in Perth, John passed the information on
sentences.zh: 约翰仍然对她为何撒谎否认泰根的存在感到困惑，并对她被送往珀斯一个家庭生活的解释感到费解，于是他将这些信息传递给了

sentences.en: to the police.
sentences.zh: 警方。

sentences.en: When Kelly Lane's file landed at Manly Police Station, the detective assigned to recognised the name right away.
sentences.zh: 当凯莉·莱恩的档案送到曼利警察局时，负责的侦探立刻认出了这个名字。

sentences.en: The Lanes were well known and respected around Manly, a bustling seaside suburb in Sydney's Northern Beaches region, an area known colloquially as
sentences.zh: 莱恩一家在曼利非常出名且受人尊敬，曼利是悉尼北部海滩地区一个繁华的海滨郊区，该地区俗称

sentences.en: the Insula Peninsula due to its close-knit reputation.
sentences.zh: “孤岛半岛”，因为这里的人际关系非常紧密。

sentences.en: Not only were the Lanes heavily involved in the local sporting community, Kelly's father Rob had recently retired as a sergeant from Manly Police Station.
sentences.zh: 莱恩一家不仅积极参与当地的体育社区活动，凯莉的父亲罗布最近刚从曼利警察局退休，警衔为警长。

sentences.en: Digging into the personal life of his only daughter wasn't exactly a welcome task.
sentences.zh: 深入调查他唯一女儿的私生活，这绝不是一项受欢迎的任务。

sentences.en: By all accounts, the blonde and bubbly Kelly was a popular social butterfly who many regarded as a golden girl.
sentences.zh: 据各方描述，金发活泼的凯莉是一个受欢迎的社交达人，许多人视她为“黄金女孩”。

sentences.en: A successful athlete from a young age, she'd gone on to play water polo at an elite level, even representing Australia overseas.
sentences.zh: 她从小就是一名成功的运动员，后来参加了精英级别的女子水球比赛，甚至代表澳大利亚参加过海外赛事。

sentences.en: As far as police were concerned, Kelly's previous indiscretion wasn't a high priority.
sentences.zh: 在警方看来，凯莉之前的“轻率行为”并不是什么优先事项。

sentences.en: Unaware of the various versions of events Kelly had told about her second-born child, the detective looked over her file.
sentences.zh: 由于不知道凯莉关于她第二个孩子所说的各种版本，侦探翻阅了她的档案。

sentences.en: Hospital records revealed that on the afternoon of
sentences.zh: 医院记录显示，在

sentences.en: Wednesday September 11, 1996, 21-year-old Kelly had presented at Auburn Hospital in Western Sydney.
sentences.zh: 1996年9月11日星期三下午，21岁的凯莉出现在悉尼西部的奥本医院。

sentences.en: This was around 35 kilometres from where Kelly lived with her parents in the suburb of Fairlight and she'd never been a patient there before
sentences.zh: 这里距离凯莉与父母居住的费尔莱特郊区约35公里，她以前从未在那里就诊过。

sentences.en: Kelly, who was heavily pregnant, told staff that she'd been intending to have a home birth with a private midwife
sentences.zh: 当时已怀有身孕的凯莉告诉医护人员，她原本打算由私人助产士进行家庭分娩。

sentences.en: However, her baby was overdue, so a home birth was no longer possible
sentences.zh: 然而，由于预产期已过，家庭分娩已不再可能。

sentences.en: Kelly asked to be induced instead
sentences.zh: 凯莉转而要求进行引产。

sentences.en: While she didn't bring any of her antenatal records with her, she gave staff the contact number for her midwife
sentences.zh: 虽然她没有携带任何产前检查记录，但她向工作人员提供了助产士的联系电话。

sentences.en: After several unsuccessful attempts to contact Kelly's midwife, the Auburn Hospital staff agreed to induce her the following day
sentences.zh: 在多次尝试联系凯莉的助产士未果后，奥本医院的工作人员同意在第二天为她引产。

sentences.en: At 8pm on Thursday September 12, baby Teagan Lee Lane entered the world
sentences.zh: 9月12日星期四晚上8点，女婴蒂根·李·莱恩降生了。

sentences.en: While Tegan was the image of health, the birth wasn't without complications.
sentences.zh: 虽然蒂根看起来非常健康，但分娩过程并非没有并发症。

sentences.en: It turned out that Tegan wasn't overdue as Kelly had claimed, but actually appeared to be two weeks early.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，蒂根并非像凯莉所说的那样过了预产期，实际上她似乎早产了两周。

sentences.en: Kelly's placenta was retained during labour and had to be manually removed, which resulted in significant blood loss.
sentences.zh: 凯莉在分娩过程中胎盘滞留，不得不进行人工剥离，导致了严重失血。

sentences.en: She made a quick recovery and records showed she bonded well with her newborn daughter.
sentences.zh: 她恢复得很快，记录显示她与刚出生的女儿建立了良好的母婴关系。

sentences.en: Regardless, the staff were a little concerned.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，医护人员还是有些担忧。

sentences.en: Kelly had shown up alone at the hospital and hadn't had a single visitor.
sentences.zh: 凯莉是独自一人来到医院的，而且没有一个访客。

sentences.en: This was unusual for a young mother and they were worried about her lack of support.
sentences.zh: 这对于一位年轻母亲来说很不寻常，他们担心她缺乏支持。

sentences.en: Social worker Alicia Boutra-Vazquez was assigned to pay Kelly a visit on Friday September 13.
sentences.zh: 社会工作者艾丽西亚·布特拉-瓦斯克斯被指派在9月13日星期五探望凯莉。

sentences.en: Kelly told Alicia that she and Tegan's father, Duncan Gillies, had only recently relocated to
sentences.zh: 凯莉告诉艾丽西亚，她和蒂根的父亲邓肯·吉利斯刚从家乡珀斯搬到

sentences.en: Sydney from their hometown of Perth, and that's why she was alone.
sentences.zh: 悉尼，所以她才是一个人。

sentences.en: Duncan had every intention of being present for Tegan's birth, but Kelly being overdue complicated this plan, as he had rugby commitments overseas.
sentences.zh: 邓肯本打算出席蒂根的出生，但凯莉预产期推迟打乱了计划，因为他当时有海外的橄榄球比赛任务。

sentences.en: Kelly asked to be discharged the following day, but Alicia didn't think this was a good idea.
sentences.zh: 凯莉要求第二天出院，但艾丽西亚认为这并不是个好主意。

sentences.en: While Kelly appeared to be happy with Tegan and was breastfeeding with no issues, she also got a bit teary at times.
sentences.zh: 虽然凯莉看起来对蒂根很满意，母乳喂养也很顺利，但她有时会流泪。

sentences.en: Although this was normal for any new mother, Alicia was reluctant to send Kelly home alone in an emotionally fragile state.
sentences.zh: 尽管这对任何新手妈妈来说都很正常，但艾丽西亚不愿让情绪脆弱的凯莉独自回家。

sentences.en: She also required post-operative care.
sentences.zh: 她还需要术后护理。

sentences.en: Alicia voiced her concerns to Kelly, but Kelly assured her there was no reason to worry.
sentences.zh: 艾丽西亚向凯莉表达了她的担忧，但凯莉向她保证不必担心。

sentences.en: She explained that a lady was coming to stay with her until her parents arrived in a few days' time.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，有一位女士会来陪她，直到几天后她的父母赶到。

sentences.en: Duncan was also due back from overseas the following week.
sentences.zh: 邓肯也预计在下周从海外回来。

sentences.en: In the meantime, her private midwife would take over her postpartum care.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，她的私人助产士将接手她的产后护理。

sentences.en: Satisfied with this explanation and happy with Kelly's recovery, on Saturday September 14, it was agreed by hospital staff that Kelly and Tegan could be discharged.
sentences.zh: 对这个解释感到满意，且对凯莉的恢复情况感到放心，9月14日星期六，医院工作人员同意凯莉和蒂根可以出院。

sentences.en: At around midday, the attending doctor gave Teagan one final examination before concluding she was fit to go home.
sentences.zh: 中午左右，主治医生对蒂根进行了最后一次检查，确认她适合出院。

sentences.en: Kelly completed the mandatory Medicare form and was given various pieces of paperwork to fill out, including a consent form to have a blood sample taken from Teagan,
sentences.zh: 凯莉填写了强制性的医疗保险表格，并收到了各种需要填写的文书，包括一份为蒂根采集血样的同意书，

sentences.en: known as a Guthrie test, as well as a registration form to submit to the registry of births, deaths and marriages.
sentences.zh: 即所谓的“格思里测试”，以及一份提交给出生、死亡和婚姻登记处的登记表。

sentences.en: At around 2pm, the nurse on duty was doing her rounds when she entered Kelly's room, only to find that the mother and baby had already left
sentences.zh: 下午2点左右，当班护士在查房时走进凯莉的房间，却发现母婴二人已经离开了。

sentences.en: Strange, she thought, when Kelly hadn't submitted the requisite paperwork, nor told any of the nurses she was leaving
sentences.zh: 她觉得很奇怪，因为凯莉既没有提交必要的文书，也没有告诉任何护士她要离开。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, she was free to do as she pleased
sentences.zh: 不过，她有权自由行动。

sentences.en: The nurse arranged for a hospital midwife to visit Kelly in a couple of days' time to make sure everything was in order
sentences.zh: 护士安排了一名医院助产士在几天后去探望凯莉，以确保一切正常。

sentences.en: But on Monday, the midwife program received a phone call
sentences.zh: 但周一，助产士项目组接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: It was Kelly, calling to say she didn't require their services
sentences.zh: 是凯莉打来的，说她不需要他们的服务了。

sentences.en: Her private midwife had everything under control
sentences.zh: 她的私人助产士已经处理好了一切。

sentences.en: Four years later, the detective assigned to look into Tegan Lane's whereabouts typed Tegan's name into the New South Wales Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages.
sentences.zh: 四年后，负责调查蒂根·莱恩下落的侦探将蒂根的名字输入了新南威尔士州出生、死亡和婚姻登记处系统。

sentences.en: There was no one by that name registered as being born in September 1996 and no such birth certificate had ever been issued.
sentences.zh: 没有登记显示1996年9月出生的人叫这个名字，也没有签发过这样的出生证明。

sentences.en: While it would have been difficult to do so, it was possible that Tegan could have been registered under a different name or with a different date of birth.
sentences.zh: 虽然很难做到，但蒂根也有可能以不同的名字或不同的出生日期进行了登记。

sentences.en: It was mandatory for parents to register the birth of their children, but failure to do so only resulted in a $1,000 fine and no particular authority followed up.
sentences.zh: 父母必须登记子女的出生，但未登记只会导致1000美元的罚款，并没有专门的机构进行后续跟进。

sentences.en: It was therefore possible that Tegan's birth was simply never registered.
sentences.zh: 因此，蒂根的出生可能根本就没有登记。

sentences.en: The detective read over Kelly's hospital records and noted that she had listed her private midwife as a woman named Julie Melville.
sentences.zh: 侦探阅读了凯莉的医院记录，注意到她将私人助产士列为一名叫朱莉·梅尔维尔的女性。

sentences.en: Some around Manly Police Station recognised the name
sentences.zh: 曼利警察局里有些人认出了这个名字。

sentences.en: Julie was Duncan Gilley's mother
sentences.zh: 朱莉是邓肯·吉利斯的母亲。

sentences.en: The detective called Julie Melville and asked her about the postnatal care she'd provided to Kelly Lane and baby Teagan
sentences.zh: 侦探打电话给朱莉·梅尔维尔，询问她为凯莉·莱恩和婴儿蒂根提供的产后护理情况。

sentences.en: Julie was stunned
sentences.zh: 朱莉惊呆了。

sentences.en: Not only had she not been a registered midwife in September 1996 She had no idea that Kelly had ever been pregnant let alone with her son's child.
sentences.zh: 她不仅在1996年9月不是注册助产士，而且她根本不知道凯莉曾经怀孕，更不用说是她儿子的孩子了。

sentences.en: Duncan Gillies was still trying to get his head around the debacle involving the adoption of Kelly's son Jacob
sentences.zh: 邓肯·吉利斯当时还在努力应对凯莉儿子雅各布被领养所引发的混乱，

sentences.en: when he received a phone call from the detective asking about baby Teagan.
sentences.zh: 这时他接到了侦探关于婴儿蒂根的电话。

sentences.en: Like his mother, Duncan was flabbergasted.
sentences.zh: 和他的母亲一样，邓肯也惊呆了。

sentences.en: He told the detective there was no way Kelly could have been pregnant in 1996.
sentences.zh: 他告诉侦探，凯莉在1996年不可能怀孕。

sentences.en: The two had been in a committed relationship for around four years between 1994 and 1998
sentences.zh: 两人在1994年至1998年间保持了大约四年的稳定恋爱关系。

sentences.en: Although they both had busy schedules with various sporting commitments during that time
sentences.zh: 尽管那段时间他们都有繁忙的体育赛事安排，

sentences.en: Kelly spent several nights a week at Duncan's house in 1996
sentences.zh: 但1996年凯莉每周有几个晚上都住在邓肯家。

sentences.en: Duncan said if she'd been pregnant, he would have known about it
sentences.zh: 邓肯说如果她怀孕了，他肯定会知道。

sentences.en: As for baby Kayla being born in 1995 he claimed to have no idea about that pregnancy either.
sentences.zh: 至于1995年出生的婴儿凯拉，他声称对那次怀孕也一无所知。

sentences.en: Although the detective was confused by these reactions, it took three months before he reached out to Kelly Lane directly.
sentences.zh: 虽然侦探对这些反应感到困惑，但直到三个月后他才直接联系凯莉·莱恩。

sentences.en: By this point, 15 months had passed since Doc's social worker,
sentences.zh: 此时，距离医生社工

sentences.en: John Barovnik, first alerted the police to the unknown whereabouts of Teagan Lane.
sentences.zh: 约翰·巴罗夫尼克首次向警方通报蒂根·莱恩下落不明已经过去了15个月。

sentences.en: Kelly's life had changed significantly during that time.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，凯莉的生活发生了重大变化。

sentences.en: Jacob's adoption had been finalised and Kelly commenced a new relationship with a family friend.
sentences.zh: 雅各布的领养手续已经完成，凯莉开始了一段与一位家庭朋友的新恋情。

sentences.en: By the time she was brought into the police station on Wednesday February 14, 2001 for her first formal interview, she was seven months pregnant with baby number four.
sentences.zh: 当她在2001年2月14日星期三被带到警察局进行第一次正式问话时，她已经怀上了第四个孩子，怀孕七个月了。

sentences.en: When asked to describe the circumstances of Tegan's birth and the subsequent events, Kelly's discomfort was obvious.
sentences.zh: 当被要求描述蒂根出生及随后的情况时，凯莉明显感到不安。

sentences.en: She admitted that in late 1995, during her relationship with Duncan Gillies, she'd met an older man named Andrew Morris
sentences.zh: 她承认在1995年底，在与邓肯·吉利斯交往期间，她认识了一位名叫安德鲁·莫里斯的年长男子。

sentences.en: The two had a brief affair and in March 1996, Kelly discovered she was pregnant with Andrew's baby
sentences.zh: 两人有过一段短暂的恋情，1996年3月，凯莉发现自己怀上了安德鲁的孩子。

sentences.en: This wasn't welcome news
sentences.zh: 这并不是什么好消息。

sentences.en: Kelly was a student at the time and she didn't feel financially or mentally prepared to raise a child
sentences.zh: 凯莉当时还是个学生，她觉得在经济上和心理上都没有准备好抚养孩子。

sentences.en: Kelly told the detective that she and Andrew came to an agreement.
sentences.zh: 凯莉告诉侦探，她和安德鲁达成了一个协议。

sentences.en: She would carry the baby to full term and Andrew and his girlfriend Mel would then take custody of Tegan.
sentences.zh: 她会把孩子生下来，然后安德鲁和他的女友梅尔会接手抚养蒂根。

sentences.en: As Kelly explained,
sentences.zh: 正如凯莉所解释的，

sentences.en: Andrew earned good money and he had a partner.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁收入不错，而且有伴侣。

sentences.en: They indicated to me that they were going to be together and I thought that would be more suitable than me on my own at uni.
sentences.zh: 他们向我表示他们会在一起，我觉得这比我一个人在大学里要合适得多。

sentences.en: Kelly said that she was discharged from hospital around midday on Saturday, September 14, 1996, at which point Andrew, Mel, and Andrew's mother came to take custody of Tegan.
sentences.zh: 凯莉说，她在1996年9月14日星期六中午左右出院，当时安德鲁、梅尔和安德鲁的母亲来接走了蒂根。

sentences.en: Kelly recalled that Andrew dropped her at Duncan's house, where she was living part-time, and then took Tegan with him into his care.
sentences.zh: 凯莉回忆说，安德鲁把她送到了她半工半读期间居住的邓肯家，然后带着蒂根离开了。

sentences.en: She claimed she saw Tegan a number of times after that, but the visit stopped in early 1997 when Teagan would have been about four months old.
sentences.zh: 她声称在那之后见过蒂根几次，但探视在1997年初停止了，当时蒂根大约四个月大。

sentences.en: Kelly said she'd had no contact with Andrew, Mel or Teagan after that and she no longer knew where they were.
sentences.zh: 凯莉说，此后她与安德鲁、梅尔或蒂根没有任何联系，也不知道他们现在在哪里。

sentences.en: Kelly said that at the time of their affair, Andrew had lived in Balmain, an affluent inner city suburb about 18 kilometres southwest of Manly.
sentences.zh: 凯莉说，在他们交往期间，安德鲁住在巴尔曼，这是一个位于曼利西南约18公里的富裕内城区。

sentences.en: While she didn't think she'd be able to identify his apartment after four years, she agreed to look for his old mobile number to see if it was still active.
sentences.zh: 虽然她认为四年后自己可能认不出他的公寓了，但她同意寻找他以前的手机号码，看看是否还能打通。

sentences.en: Although Kelly's story sounded a bit odd, the interviewing detective still didn't think too much of it.
sentences.zh: 尽管凯莉的故事听起来有点奇怪，但负责审讯的侦探并没有太在意。

sentences.en: Besides, Manly Police Station had bigger fish to fry.
sentences.zh: 此外，曼利警察局还有更重要的事情要处理。

sentences.en: Two of their senior officers had recently been busted as part of a crackdown on corruption and the whole station was in a state of turmoil.
sentences.zh: 他们的两名高级警官最近因打击腐败行动而被捕，整个警察局处于动荡之中。

sentences.en: Kelly's case languished for the rest of the year as the corruption scandal went before the courts.
sentences.zh: 随着腐败丑闻进入法庭审理，凯莉的案子在这一年的剩余时间里被搁置了。

sentences.en: It was only after a major restructure of personnel that Kelly's case finally appeared on the desk of a new detective's senior constable.
sentences.zh: 直到人员进行重大重组后，凯莉的案子才最终出现在一位新侦探高级警员的桌上。

sentences.en: Having no connection to Kelly's father, he wasted a little time in looking into what he believed would turn out to be a relatively minor incident.
sentences.zh: 由于与凯莉的父亲没有任何联系，他很快就开始调查他认为只是一起相对较小的事件。

sentences.en: All they had to do was locate Teagan, and they could get the missing person's case off their desks for good.
sentences.zh: 他们所要做的就是找到蒂根，这样他们就可以彻底结案了。

sentences.en: By the time Kelly Lane was called in for questioning a second time, 19 months had passed since she'd last spoken to the police, and it was now October 2002.
sentences.zh: 当凯莉·莱恩第二次被传唤问话时，距离她上次与警方交谈已经过去了19个月，时间已经是2002年10月了。

sentences.en: 27-year-old Kelly now had a healthy baby girl called Emily, not her real name, who was 17 months old.
sentences.zh: 27岁的凯莉现在有一个健康的女儿叫艾米丽（化名），17个月大。

sentences.en: Kelly was in a loving relationship with Emily's father and the two were doting devoted parents
sentences.zh: 凯莉与艾米丽的父亲关系融洽，两人都是慈爱且尽职的父母，

sentences.en: who were preparing to travel to the UK to spend Christmas with Kelly's partner's family.
sentences.zh: 正准备前往英国与凯莉伴侣的家人共度圣诞节。

sentences.en: Although Kelly no longer competed in any sport at an elite level, she'd made good use of her athletic skills by becoming a much-loved physical education teacher
sentences.zh: 虽然凯莉不再参加任何精英级别的体育比赛，但她很好地利用了自己的运动天赋，成为了一名深受喜爱的体育老师，

sentences.en: at Ravenswood School for Girls, an esteemed private Christian school.
sentences.zh: 任教于一所受人尊敬的私立基督教学校——雷文斯伍德女子学校。

sentences.en: There certainly wasn't anything about Kelly that raised any suspicions for the detective
sentences.zh: 侦探对凯莉确实没有任何怀疑。

sentences.en: But when she started talking, that all changed
sentences.zh: 但当她开始说话时，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持《案件档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: While Kelly Lane repeated her story about giving Teagan to the child's biological father, there was a significant discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 虽然凯莉·莱恩重复了她关于把蒂根交给孩子亲生父亲的故事，但其中存在重大出入。

sentences.en: When interviewed in early 2001, she said the father's name was Andrew Morris.
sentences.zh: 在2001年初接受采访时，她说父亲的名字是安德鲁·莫里斯（Morris）。

sentences.en: This time, she said his name was Andrew Norris, with an N.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她说他的名字是安德鲁·诺里斯（Norris），带个N。

sentences.en: But that wasn't the only difference.
sentences.zh: 但这还不是唯一的区别。

sentences.en: Her previous account made it sound like a relatively amicable agreement, but she now claimed Andrew had actually been furious with her for getting pregnant.
sentences.zh: 她之前的陈述听起来像是一个相对友好的协议，但她现在声称安德鲁实际上因为她怀孕而对她非常愤怒。

sentences.en: He hated me, Kelly said.
sentences.zh: “他恨我，”凯莉说。

sentences.en: I felt like a slut.
sentences.zh: “我觉得自己像个荡妇。”

sentences.en: In contrast to her previous story in which she claimed Andrew had dropped her at Duncan's
sentences.zh: 与她之前的说法相反，她曾声称安德鲁在出院后把她送到了邓肯家，

sentences.en: house after she was discharged from the hospital, this time Kelly said she took a taxi home alone.
sentences.zh: 这一次凯莉说她是独自打车回家的。

sentences.en: The detective pointed out this was a markedly different story to the one she'd given previously.
sentences.zh: 侦探指出，这与她之前讲述的故事有显著不同。

sentences.en: Kelly explained that she'd lied during the last police interview because she was embarrassed and wanted to make the situation sound better.
sentences.zh: 凯莉解释说，她在上次警察采访时撒了谎，因为她感到尴尬，想让情况听起来好一些。

sentences.en: But she was resolute about one thing.
sentences.zh: 但她对一件事很坚定。

sentences.en: The name of Teagan's father was definitely Andrew Norris, not Morris.
sentences.zh: 蒂根父亲的名字绝对是安德鲁·诺里斯，而不是莫里斯。

sentences.en: The detective was starting to have some serious doubts.
sentences.zh: 侦探开始产生严重的怀疑。

sentences.en: Not only had some of Kelly's details changed, there were certain elements that didn't quite make sense.
sentences.zh: 凯莉不仅改变了一些细节，而且有些要素根本说不通。

sentences.en: For starters, if Andrew was so furious with Kelly for getting pregnant, why would he agree to take custody of their baby without so much as a DNA test to confirm
sentences.zh: 首先，如果安德鲁对凯莉怀孕如此愤怒，为什么他会同意在没有进行DNA测试确认孩子确实是他亲生的情况下就接手抚养？

sentences.en: the baby was indeed his?
sentences.zh: （确认孩子确实是他）

sentences.en: Even more perplexing, why would his partner Mel agree to raise Tegan knowing she was a result of her partner's infidelity.
sentences.zh: 更令人费解的是，为什么他的伴侣梅尔会同意在知道蒂根是她伴侣不忠的结果的情况下抚养她？

sentences.en: And if Tegan really did go to live with her biological father, why wasn't Kelly forthright about that from the get-go
sentences.zh: 如果蒂根真的去和她的亲生父亲住在一起，为什么凯莉从一开始就不直说，

sentences.en: instead of telling hospital staff and social workers otherwise?
sentences.zh: 而不是告诉医院工作人员和社会工作者其他情况？

sentences.en: If Kelly's story was true, investigators just had to locate Andrew Norris and the whole mess could be cleared up.
sentences.zh: 如果凯莉的故事是真的，调查人员只需要找到安德鲁·诺里斯，整个烂摊子就能理清了。

sentences.en: The problem was, Kelly said she no longer had a contact number for Andrew nor could she remember exactly where he'd lived back in 1996.
sentences.zh: 问题是，凯莉说她不再有安德鲁的联系电话，也记不清他在1996年到底住在哪里。

sentences.en: Kelly didn't know much about Andrew at all save for the fact that he worked in finance and had studied at the University of Sydney.
sentences.zh: 凯莉对安德鲁了解不多，只知道他在金融行业工作，曾在悉尼大学学习。

sentences.en: At the time Tegan was born, he was 30 years old, well built and tanned with bleached blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 蒂根出生时，他30岁，身材魁梧，皮肤黝黑，留着漂白的金发。

sentences.en: Kelly said she no longer hung around the same crowd that she did back then but there was one friend who knew about the affair and could verify her story,
sentences.zh: 凯莉说她不再和当时的那群人来往了，但有一个朋友知道这段恋情，可以证实她的故事，

sentences.en: a woman named Lisa Andreatta.
sentences.zh: 一个叫丽莎·安德烈塔的女人。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Lisa had relocated to Brisbane and they had lost touch.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，丽莎已经搬到了布里斯班，她们失去了联系。

sentences.en: Kelly told the detective that there were some diaries of hers in storage at Duncan Gilley's previous home in Gladesville.
sentences.zh: 凯莉告诉侦探，她的一些日记存放在邓肯·吉利斯以前在格莱兹维尔的家中。

sentences.en: She promised to go collect them in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 她承诺在接下来的几天里去取回它们。

sentences.en: They might contain Andrew's old mobile number or the numbers of their mutual friends.
sentences.zh: 它们可能包含安德鲁的旧手机号码或他们共同朋友的号码。

sentences.en: Over the following weeks, the detective made multiple attempts to contact Kelly, but she seemed to be avoiding his calls.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，侦探多次尝试联系凯莉，但她似乎在回避他的电话。

sentences.en: Increasingly convinced that Kelly was lying, the detective reached out to Medicare to see if any claims had ever been made for Teagan Lee Lane.
sentences.zh: 侦探越来越确信凯莉在撒谎，于是联系了医疗保险部门，查看是否有人为蒂根·李·莱恩提出过索赔。

sentences.en: Medicare is Australia's publicly funded health insurance scheme.
sentences.zh: 医疗保险是澳大利亚的公共资助健康保险计划。

sentences.en: Individuals are required to provide their details when visiting a doctor, dentist or hospital, or when receiving a vaccination.
sentences.zh: 个人在看医生、牙医或去医院，或接种疫苗时，必须提供其详细信息。

sentences.en: Kelly's Medicare card still had Tegan's name listed on it.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的医疗保险卡上仍然列着蒂根的名字。

sentences.en: She had shown this to the police herself, explaining that she'd registered Tegan on her card just in case Tegan was ever in her care in the future.
sentences.zh: 她自己向警方出示过这张卡，解释说她把蒂根登记在卡上，以防蒂根将来由她照顾。

sentences.en: But Medicare records proved that there hadn't been a single claim for Tegan in six years.
sentences.zh: 但医疗保险记录证明，六年来没有为蒂根提出过一次索赔。

sentences.en: While it was implausible to believe that a six-year-old could have gone their whole life without needing publicly funded healthcare, it wasn't enough to prove Tegan was deceased.
sentences.zh: 虽然认为一个六岁的孩子一生中从未需要公共资助的医疗服务是不可信的，但这还不足以证明蒂根已经死亡。

sentences.en: Police sent a memo to all NSW primary schools asking if any had a student named Tegan who was born on September 12, 1996.
sentences.zh: 警方给新南威尔士州的所有小学发了一份备忘录，询问是否有学生名叫蒂根，出生于1996年9月12日。

sentences.en: They also began conducting searches for Andrew Norris.
sentences.zh: 他们也开始搜寻安德鲁·诺里斯。

sentences.en: In Kelly's first police interview, she recalled that Andrew celebrated his 30th birthday a couple of months before Tegan was born
sentences.zh: 在凯莉的第一次警察采访中，她回忆说安德鲁在蒂根出生前几个月庆祝了他的30岁生日。

sentences.en: This meant he would have been born around mid-1966
sentences.zh: 这意味着他应该出生在1966年中期左右。

sentences.en: A search of the NSW electoral roll didn't bring up any men by that name who lived in Balmain around 1996
sentences.zh: 对新南威尔士州选民名册的搜索并没有发现任何在1996年左右住在巴尔曼的同名男子。

sentences.en: Contact was made with the University of Sydney to see if anyone named Andrew Norris or Morris had attended classes there in the 1980s
sentences.zh: 警方联系了悉尼大学，查看是否有名叫安德鲁·诺里斯或莫里斯的人在20世纪80年代在那里上过课。

sentences.en: There were no former students enrolled under either of those names
sentences.zh: 没有以这两个名字注册的前学生。

sentences.en: By early December, Kelly still seemed to be avoiding the police and hadn't provided any of the information she'd promised to look for
sentences.zh: 到12月初，凯莉似乎仍在回避警方，也没有提供她承诺要寻找的任何信息。

sentences.en: Fed up with her lack of cooperation two detectives went to Duncan Gilley's former address in Gladesville to see if they could track down the information for themselves.
sentences.zh: 由于对她的不配合感到厌烦，两名侦探去了邓肯·吉利斯在格莱兹维尔的旧址，看看他们能否自己找到这些信息。

sentences.en: When they knocked on the door, they were surprised to discover that three female police officers lived there.
sentences.zh: 当他们敲门时，惊讶地发现住在那里的竟然是三名女警官。

sentences.en: The detectives asked if anyone had come by asking to look through old boxes of paperwork.
sentences.zh: 侦探们询问是否有人来过，要求翻看旧文件箱。

sentences.en: Nobody had.
sentences.zh: 没有人来过。

sentences.en: It became clear to the investigators is that if Kelly was telling the truth about anything, it was that people in her life seemingly
sentences.zh: 调查人员逐渐意识到，如果凯莉在任何事情上说了真话，那就是她生活中的人们似乎

sentences.en: had no knowledge that she'd ever been pregnant during her early twenties.
sentences.zh: 对她二十出头时曾怀孕过一事毫无所知。

sentences.en: Discreet inquiries were made with some of Kelly's close friends to see if they could shed light on the Teagan Lane-Andrew
sentences.zh: 警方对凯莉的一些密友进行了谨慎的询问，看他们能否为蒂根·莱恩（Teagan Lane）和安德鲁·诺里斯（Andrew Norris）

sentences.en: Norris situation.
sentences.zh: 的情况提供线索。

sentences.en: The Kelly they knew had spent her early twenties playing water polo and drinking at the pub with friends.
sentences.zh: 在他们眼中，凯莉二十出头时一直忙于打水球，并和朋友们在酒吧喝酒。

sentences.en: As far as they were all concerned, the only child Kelly had ever given birth to was Emily in 2001.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，凯莉唯一生下的孩子是2001年出生的艾米丽（Emily）。

sentences.en: She was a terrific mother and an adored teacher who loved children.
sentences.zh: 她是一位出色的母亲，也是一位深受爱戴、热爱孩子的老师。

sentences.en: There was no way she would have done anything to harm a newborn baby.
sentences.zh: 她绝不可能做出任何伤害新生儿的事。

sentences.en: Police managed to track down some of Kelly Lane's former water polo teammates.
sentences.zh: 警方设法找到了凯莉·莱恩（Kelly Lane）的一些前水球队友。

sentences.en: Stacey Gaylord, who'd played alongside Kelly in
sentences.zh: 斯泰西·盖洛德（Stacey Gaylord）曾与凯莉在

sentences.en: 1996, said she'd never heard of Kelly being involved with someone named Andrew Norris.
sentences.zh: 1996年并肩作战，她说从未听说过凯莉与一个叫安德鲁·诺里斯的人有往来。

sentences.en: However, she did recall being suspicious at the time that Kelly might have been pregnant.
sentences.zh: 不过，她确实记得当时曾怀疑凯莉可能怀孕了。

sentences.en: Stacey and another teammate, Taryn, both admitted they'd noticed Kelly becoming self-conscious of her body.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西和另一位队友塔琳（Taryn）都承认，她们注意到凯莉开始对自己的身体感到不自在。

sentences.en: They'd snuck a glimpse of her torso underwater to confirm their suspicions.
sentences.zh: 她们曾趁凯莉在水下时瞥了一眼她的躯干，以证实自己的怀疑。

sentences.en: But Kelly never spoke to either of them about it, nor did they ever broach the subject, assuming it was a private matter between Kelly and Duncan Gillies.
sentences.zh: 但凯莉从未与她们中的任何一人谈起过这件事，她们也没有主动提起，认为这是凯莉和邓肯·吉利斯（Duncan Gillies）之间的私事。

sentences.en: They also knew that weight gain was a sensitive subject among young women, and they were mindful that their suspicions might be incorrect.
sentences.zh: 她们也知道体重增加在年轻女性中是个敏感话题，因此担心自己的怀疑可能是错的。

sentences.en: The more the police learned, the stranger the whole scenario became.
sentences.zh: 警方了解得越多，整个情况就变得越离奇。

sentences.en: Kelly had given birth three times in the four years between 1995 and 1999.
sentences.zh: 在1995年到1999年这四年间，凯莉生了三次孩子。

sentences.en: During each of those pregnancies, she'd been a dedicated water polo player who lived a very active social life and was intimate with her long-term boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 在每次怀孕期间，她都是一名敬业的水球运动员，过着非常活跃的社交生活，并与长期男友保持着亲密关系。

sentences.en: While women's fashion at the time consisted of baggy, loose-fitting clothing, it was staggering
sentences.zh: 虽然当时的女性时尚流行宽松肥大的服装，但令人震惊的是，

sentences.en: to believe that she could have concealed three full-term pregnancies, especially while playing water polo in a swimsuit multiple times a week.
sentences.zh: 很难相信她能隐瞒三次足月妊娠，尤其是在她每周多次穿着泳衣打水球的情况下。

sentences.en: Duncan claimed that in 1996 both he and Kelly were busy with their respective training schedules and therefore they didn't see much of each other.
sentences.zh: 邓肯声称，1996年他和凯莉都忙于各自的训练计划，因此两人见面不多。

sentences.en: On the occasions they did have sex, it was in a spoon position and Kelly hadn't let him touch her belly, saying she was self-conscious because she'd gained weight
sentences.zh: 在他们发生性关系的几次场合中，都是采用勺型姿势，而且凯莉不让他碰她的肚子，说她因为体重增加而感到自卑。

sentences.en: Kelly said the one person who could vouch for her story was her old friend, Lisa Andreatta, whom she'd lost touch with after Lisa moved to Brisbane
sentences.zh: 凯莉说，唯一能为她的故事作证的人是她的老朋友丽莎·安德里亚塔（Lisa Andreatta），丽莎搬到布里斯班后，她们就失去了联系。

sentences.en: Police managed to track down Lisa's email address And they sent her a message asking if she could verify a few details
sentences.zh: 警方设法找到了丽莎的电子邮箱，并给她发了信息，询问她是否能核实一些细节，

sentences.en: About Kelly Lane's relationship with Andrew Norris And the subsequent birth of their baby, Teagan
sentences.zh: 关于凯莉·莱恩与安德鲁·诺里斯的关系，以及随后他们孩子蒂根的出生。

sentences.en: Lisa was completely taken aback
sentences.zh: 丽莎完全惊呆了。

sentences.en: She had met Kelly while the two were completing tertiary studies At the Australian College of Physical Education And they became good friends
sentences.zh: 她是在澳大利亚体育教育学院完成高等教育时认识凯莉的，她们成了好朋友。

sentences.en: Lisa had never heard of Andrew Norris nor about his alleged affair with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 丽莎从未听说过安德鲁·诺里斯，也不知道他和凯莉所谓的恋情。

sentences.en: As far as Lisa knew, Kelly was never pregnant in 1996.
sentences.zh: 在丽莎看来，凯莉在1996年从未怀孕过。

sentences.en: Lisa lived in the UK, not Brisbane, and she'd never lost contact with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 丽莎住在英国，而不是布里斯班，而且她从未与凯莉失去联系。

sentences.en: In fact, the two friends had recently caught up over Christmas during Kelly's trip to England.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这两位朋友最近在凯莉去英国旅行期间还一起过了圣诞节。

sentences.en: At no point had Kelly said anything to Lisa about a missing child or a police investigation.
sentences.zh: 凯莉从未向丽莎提起过任何关于失踪孩子或警方调查的事情。

sentences.en: Failing to find any record of Tegan Lane or Andrew Norris, the police had no doubt that Kelly was lying.
sentences.zh: 由于找不到蒂根·莱恩或安德鲁·诺里斯的任何记录，警方毫不怀疑凯莉在撒谎。

sentences.en: They just couldn't figure out why.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想不通为什么。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense that she'd gone through the official adoption process with babies Kayla and Jacob, but not with Tegan.
sentences.zh: 她曾为凯拉（Kayla）和雅各布（Jacob）这两个孩子办理过正式的领养手续，却没为蒂根办理，这说不通。

sentences.en: Was she trying to protect herself or someone else.
sentences.zh: 她是在保护自己还是别人？

sentences.en: Investigators considered the possibility that Kelly could have sold Tegan in a private surrogacy arrangement, which is illegal in Australia.
sentences.zh: 调查人员考虑过凯莉可能通过私人代孕协议卖掉了蒂根，这在澳大利亚是违法的。

sentences.en: They checked
sentences.zh: 他们检查了

sentences.en: Kelly's bank accounts, but she hadn't received any large sums of money in 1996.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的银行账户，但她在1996年并没有收到任何大额款项。

sentences.en: She'd been a student at the time, living at home with her parents, and her bank accounts were barely touched.
sentences.zh: 她当时还是个学生，和父母住在一起，她的银行账户几乎没动过。

sentences.en: None of Kelly's friends recalled any changes in her spending habits
sentences.zh: 凯莉的朋友们都不记得她的消费习惯有任何改变。

sentences.en: Police obtained a record of all the other babies born in Auburn Hospital on September 12, 1996
sentences.zh: 警方获取了1996年9月12日在奥本医院（Auburn Hospital）出生的所有其他婴儿的记录。

sentences.en: Tegan was one of only two girls born that day
sentences.zh: 蒂根是那天出生的仅有的两个女婴之一。

sentences.en: The other baby girl had been stillborn
sentences.zh: 另一个女婴是死胎。

sentences.en: This prompted the theory
sentences.zh: 这引发了一个推测：

sentences.en: What if Kelly, in a moment of desperation, had brokered a deal with the bereaved mother?
sentences.zh: 如果凯莉在绝望中与那位失去孩子的母亲达成了某种协议呢？

sentences.en: The mother of the stillborn child was tracked down.
sentences.zh: 警方找到了那位死胎母亲。

sentences.en: She now had two children, but neither was Tegan Lane, and she hadn't ever crossed paths with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 她现在有两个孩子，但都不是蒂根·莱恩，而且她从未与凯莉有过交集。

sentences.en: In each version of events Kelly had given, she claimed that after Tegan's birth, she went back to Duncan's house in Gladesville.
sentences.zh: 在凯莉给出的每一个版本中，她都声称蒂根出生后，她回到了邓肯在格莱兹维尔（Gladesville）的家中。

sentences.en: Working on the theory that Tegan could have been killed or died by accident, officers visited the property with a cadaver dog and conducted a cursory search.
sentences.zh: 基于蒂根可能被杀或意外死亡的推测，警官带着搜尸犬前往该住所进行了初步搜查。

sentences.en: While it yielded no results, they were no longer prepared to give Kelly the benefit of the doubt.
sentences.zh: 虽然一无所获，但他们不再准备给凯莉任何怀疑的余地。

sentences.en: In May 2003, Kelly was summoned back to Manly Police Station for a formal recorded interview.
sentences.zh: 2003年5月，凯莉被传唤回曼利（Manly）警察局进行正式录音访谈。

sentences.en: Confronted with the inconsistencies in her accounts, Kelly maintained the crux of her story, that Andrew Norris and his partner Mel had taken custody of baby Teagan
sentences.zh: 面对陈述中的前后矛盾，凯莉坚持她故事的核心，即安德鲁·诺里斯和他的伴侣梅尔（Mel）带走了婴儿蒂根。

sentences.en: The detective asked if this was the case, why did Kelly tell Virginia Fung that Teagan had gone to live with a couple in Perth
sentences.zh: 侦探问，如果是这样，为什么凯莉告诉弗吉尼亚·冯（Virginia Fung）说蒂根去和珀斯的一对夫妇生活了？

sentences.en: Kelly responded, I'm not sure where they are, I wasn't sure what Andrew was going to do
sentences.zh: 凯莉回答说：“我不确定他们在哪里，我不确定安德鲁会做什么。”

sentences.en: Confused by this explanation, the detective asked Kelly if she was suggesting that Andrew had relocated to Perth.
sentences.zh: 侦探对这个解释感到困惑，问凯莉是否在暗示安德鲁搬到了珀斯。

sentences.en: Kelly replied, I'm not sure what his plans were.
sentences.zh: 凯莉回答说：“我不确定他的计划是什么。”

sentences.en: He wasn't going to tell me.
sentences.zh: “他不会告诉我的。”

sentences.en: Some of the conversations I had with Andrew indicated perhaps he wasn't going to stay in
sentences.zh: “我和安德鲁的一些谈话表明，也许他不会留在

sentences.en: Sydney because of the embarrassment that I'd caused him.
sentences.zh: 悉尼，因为我让他感到尴尬。”

sentences.en: Unaware that investigators had already conducted their own inquiries, Kelly was caught in multiple lies.
sentences.zh: 由于不知道调查人员已经进行了自己的调查，凯莉陷入了多重谎言之中。

sentences.en: She claimed that she'd retrieved her paperwork from Duncan's old house but couldn't find any contact numbers for people who could verify Andrew's existence.
sentences.zh: 她声称她从邓肯的老房子里取回了文件，但找不到任何能证实安德鲁存在的人的联系电话。

sentences.en: She also maintained that she no longer had contact with the one person who could, Lisa Andreata.
sentences.zh: 她还坚持说她不再与唯一能证实此事的人——丽莎·安德里亚塔——有联系。

sentences.en: The detective told her,
sentences.zh: 侦探告诉她：

sentences.en: Kelly, it's obvious that you're not telling us the truth
sentences.zh: “凯莉，很明显你没有对我们说实话。”

sentences.en: This matter is not going to go away
sentences.zh: “这件事不会就这么算了。”

sentences.en: He urged Kelly to come clean
sentences.zh: 他敦促凯莉坦白交代。

sentences.en: All they had to do was establish where Tegan was And Kelly could move on with her life
sentences.zh: 他们只需要确定蒂根在哪里，凯莉就能继续她的生活。

sentences.en: The detective pressed on
sentences.zh: 侦探继续追问：

sentences.en: You've been telling us lies for whatever reason If you know where the child is or what happened to the child
sentences.zh: “不管出于什么原因，你一直在对我们撒谎。如果你知道孩子在哪里，或者孩子发生了什么事，

sentences.en: It's your opportunity to tell us now
sentences.zh: 现在是你告诉我们的机会。”

sentences.en: Kelly Lane sat in silence She looked down at her hands which were resting on the table in front of her as though she was deep in thought
sentences.zh: 凯莉·莱恩沉默不语。她低头看着放在面前桌子上的双手，仿佛陷入了沉思。

sentences.en: The seconds ticked by until almost a minute passed
sentences.zh: 时间一秒一秒过去，直到将近一分钟后。

sentences.en: The detective asked her again if there was anything she wanted to say
sentences.zh: 侦探再次问她是否有什么想说的。

sentences.en: After 14 more seconds of silence, Kelly responded quietly
sentences.zh: 在又沉默了14秒后，凯莉轻声回答：

sentences.en: No
sentences.zh: “没有。”

sentences.en: The detective then asked Kelly outright if she had killed Tegan.
sentences.zh: 侦探随后直接问凯莉是否杀了蒂根。

sentences.en: Kelly's demeanour immediately changed, her eyes widening as she firmly exclaimed,
sentences.zh: 凯莉的神情立刻变了，她双眼圆睁，坚定地喊道：

sentences.en: No, I did not.
sentences.zh: “不，我没有。”

sentences.en: Kelly said that no one else knew about the situation and she didn't want her family and friends being pulled into it.
sentences.zh: 凯莉说没有其他人知道这件事，她不想让她的家人和朋友被卷进来。

sentences.en: She warned the detectives that if they went poking around, no one would have any idea what they were talking about.
sentences.zh: 她警告侦探，如果他们到处打听，没人会知道他们在说什么。

sentences.en: Despite previously telling the police that she wouldn't be able to locate Andrew's former unit,
sentences.zh: 尽管之前告诉警方她无法找到安德鲁以前的公寓，

sentences.en: Kelly agreed to accompany manly detectives to Balmain to see if something might trigger her memory.
sentences.zh: 凯莉还是同意陪同曼利侦探前往巴尔曼（Balmain），看看是否能触发她的记忆。

sentences.en: It had been many years since she'd frequented that side of town And Kelly couldn't remember any details that could help her identify the building
sentences.zh: 她已经很多年没去过城里的那一带了，凯莉记不起任何能帮她识别那栋建筑的细节。

sentences.en: All she remembered was that Andrew's place was about a 5 to 10 minute walk from the Town Hall Hotel
sentences.zh: 她只记得安德鲁的住处距离市政厅酒店（Town Hall Hotel）大约5到10分钟的步行路程。

sentences.en: Kelly said that over the 6 months they'd been seeing each other
sentences.zh: 凯莉说，在他们交往的6个月里，

sentences.en: She'd only gone back there about 6 times
sentences.zh: 她只去过那里大约6次。

sentences.en: Always in the early morning hours after a night out
sentences.zh: 总是在外出后的清晨时分。

sentences.en: The police wove through various neighbourhoods until they made their way down Whizbeach Street, a residential tree-lined street dotted mostly with freestanding houses.
sentences.zh: 警方穿过各个街区，直到他们沿着惠兹比奇街（Whizbeach Street）走下去，这是一条绿树成荫的住宅街，大多是独栋房屋。

sentences.en: As they passed by one of the only apartment buildings on the street, Kelly pointed it out.
sentences.zh: 当他们经过街上仅有的几栋公寓楼之一时，凯莉指了出来。

sentences.en: She thought that might be it.
sentences.zh: 她认为可能是那栋。

sentences.en: It was a nondescript three-storey block of units with an undercover car park and two sets of windows overlooking the street.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋不起眼的三层公寓楼，带有地下停车场，有两排窗户俯瞰着街道。

sentences.en: They got out of the car and went into the foyer
sentences.zh: 他们下了车，走进门厅。

sentences.en: It was just as Kelly remembered
sentences.zh: 正如凯莉记忆中的那样。

sentences.en: Kelly said that Andrew's unit had been on the first floor facing the street
sentences.zh: 凯莉说安德鲁的公寓在二楼（注：澳洲First floor通常指二楼），面向街道。

sentences.en: Although she couldn't remember which one or much else about it
sentences.zh: 虽然她记不清具体是哪一间，也记不清关于它的其他太多信息。

sentences.en: A tenant on the ground floor let them in And Kelly confirmed the layout was exactly the same
sentences.zh: 一楼的一位住户让他们进去，凯莉确认布局完全一样。

sentences.en: This was a major breakthrough for detectives
sentences.zh: 这对侦探来说是一个重大突破。

sentences.en: There were only two first floor units overlooking the street, Units 10 and 11.
sentences.zh: 二楼只有两间面向街道的公寓，即10号和11号。

sentences.en: For the first time since their inquiries began, they had a possible solid lead to track Andrew Norris down.
sentences.zh: 自调查开始以来，他们第一次有了追踪安德鲁·诺里斯的可能线索。

sentences.en: It turned out that the entire building was managed by a single real estate agency.
sentences.zh: 结果发现整栋楼由一家房地产中介管理。

sentences.en: Detectives contacted the agent, who went through their records to see if an Andrew Norris had lived there in 1996.
sentences.zh: 侦探联系了中介，中介翻阅了记录，查看1996年是否有一个叫安德鲁·诺里斯的人住过那里。

sentences.en: They had no records of a tenant by that name
sentences.zh: 他们没有那个名字的租户记录。

sentences.en: At the time Kelly claimed to have visited the property, Unit 10 was occupied by a man named Sean Greaves
sentences.zh: 在凯莉声称访问该房产时，10号公寓住着一个叫肖恩·格里夫斯（Sean Greaves）的人。

sentences.en: Although he was of similar age to Andrew Norris, Sean didn't fit the description Kelly had provided
sentences.zh: 虽然他与安德鲁·诺里斯年龄相仿，但肖恩并不符合凯莉提供的描述。

sentences.en: When questioned, Sean said he'd never lived with a woman named Mel, nor did he know a woman named Kelly Lane
sentences.zh: 当被问及时，肖恩说他从未和一个叫梅尔的女人住在一起，也不认识一个叫凯莉·莱恩的女人。

sentences.en: He'd never had housemates or sublet his apartment either.
sentences.zh: 他也没有过室友，也没有转租过他的公寓。

sentences.en: In 1996, Unit 11 had been leased by two brothers, Peter and Stephen Clark.
sentences.zh: 1996年，11号公寓由两兄弟彼得（Peter）和斯蒂芬·克拉克（Stephen Clark）租用。

sentences.en: Neither of them recalled ever seeing Kelly Lane in the building.
sentences.zh: 他们两人都不记得在楼里见过凯莉·莱恩。

sentences.en: One of the brothers did know a man named Andrew Morris, but he was of Asian appearance and had never visited their unit.
sentences.zh: 其中一个兄弟确实认识一个叫安德鲁·莫里斯（Andrew Morris）的人，但他长相是亚洲人，从未去过他们的公寓。

sentences.en: Neither they nor any of the other former tenants recalled ever having seen mail addressed to an Andrew Norris or Morris
sentences.zh: 他们和其他前租户都不记得见过寄给安德鲁·诺里斯或莫里斯的信件。

sentences.en: Kelly had told the detectives that on a couple of occasions after visiting Andrew she went straight to her early morning water polo training sessions at the Dawn Fraser Pool
sentences.zh: 凯莉曾告诉侦探，有几次在拜访安德鲁后，她直接去了道恩·弗雷泽游泳池（Dawn Fraser Pool）参加清晨的水球训练。

sentences.en: which was only a short walk away
sentences.zh: 那里离得很近。

sentences.en: Further investigation revealed that these training sessions weren't even held at the Dawn Fraser Pool but at another location, a 20-minute drive, across town.
sentences.zh: 进一步调查显示，这些训练甚至不是在道恩·弗雷泽游泳池举行的，而是在另一个地方，开车需要20分钟，穿过整个城市。

sentences.en: With Kelly's lies piling up, the hunt for Andrew Norris intensified.
sentences.zh: 随着凯莉的谎言越积越多，对安德鲁·诺里斯的搜捕力度加大了。

sentences.en: Investigators ran a search for anyone with that name born between 1960 and 1976 in the registry of each state and territory in Australia.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在澳大利亚各州和领地的登记处搜索了1960年至1976年间出生且名字相同的所有人。

sentences.en: They ran checks with the Australian Taxation Office, the Electoral Commission, the Department of Immigration, the Roads and Traffic Authority and Centrelink.
sentences.zh: 他们向澳大利亚税务局、选举委员会、移民局、道路与交通管理局和福利署进行了核查。

sentences.en: Utility and telecommunication providers who serviced the Balmain area were contacted, as was Australia PoSt. Police records were checked
sentences.zh: 他们联系了为巴尔曼地区提供服务的公用事业和电信供应商，以及澳大利亚邮政。警方记录也被核查了，

sentences.en: to see if Andrew Norris had been listed anywhere as a missing person.
sentences.zh: 看看安德鲁·诺里斯是否被列为失踪人员。

sentences.en: Eventually, they had a list of 41 men named Andrew Norris who were born in Australia between 1960 and 1976.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们得到了一份名单，上面有41名1960年至1976年间在澳大利亚出生的叫安德鲁·诺里斯的男子。

sentences.en: Contact was made with most of them, but none had been in Balmain at the time Teagan Lane was conceived, nor did they know a Kelly or Teagan Lane.
sentences.zh: 他们联系了其中大多数人，但没有人在蒂根·莱恩受孕时在巴尔曼，也不认识凯莉或蒂根·莱恩。

sentences.en: They decided not to extend the search to include the name Andrew Morris.
sentences.zh: 他们决定不再将搜索范围扩大到安德鲁·莫里斯这个名字。

sentences.en: Morris was a much more common surname and searching for anyone with that name born over the same 16-year period would have yielded thousands of possibilities around the country.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯是一个非常普遍的姓氏，搜索在同一16年期间出生的任何叫这个名字的人，会在全国范围内产生数千种可能性。

sentences.en: Besides, Kelly remained adamant that Norris was the correct name, though this did little to sway detectives.
sentences.zh: 此外，凯莉仍然坚称诺里斯是正确的名字，尽管这对侦探来说没什么说服力。

sentences.en: They were more convinced than ever that Andrew Norris was a fictional character created by Kelly.
sentences.zh: 他们比以往任何时候都更确信安德鲁·诺里斯是凯莉虚构出来的人物。

sentences.en: But if Andrew wasn't real, then who was Teagan's father?
sentences.zh: 但如果安德鲁不是真的，那蒂根的父亲是谁？

sentences.en: Some suspected it was Duncan Gillies, just as Kelly initially claimed.
sentences.zh: 有些人怀疑是邓肯·吉利斯，正如凯莉最初声称的那样。

sentences.en: Because Kelly never had a Guthrie test done for Teagan, there were no medical records to check anyone's DNA againSt.
sentences.zh: 因为凯莉从未给蒂根做过足跟血筛查，所以没有医疗记录可以用来核对任何人的DNA。

sentences.en: Police tracked down a man named Juan Ramirez who had lived with Duncan Gillies in 1996.
sentences.zh: 警方找到了一个叫胡安·拉米雷斯（Juan Ramirez）的人，他曾在1996年与邓肯·吉利斯住在一起。

sentences.en: According to Juan, Duncan had confided in him back then that Kelly was pregnant and that they had to keep it a secret from Kelly's family.
sentences.zh: 据胡安说，邓肯当时曾向他吐露凯莉怀孕了，他们必须对凯莉的家人保密。

sentences.en: Juan recalled Duncan saying that Kelly was going away to have the child, which she would then place for adoption.
sentences.zh: 胡安记得邓肯说凯莉要离开去生下孩子，然后会送去领养。

sentences.en: Duncan Gillies firmly denied this.
sentences.zh: 邓肯·吉利斯坚决否认了这一点。

sentences.en: He didn't consider Juan a close friend, let alone a confidant.
sentences.zh: 他并不认为胡安是密友，更不用说是知己了。

sentences.en: As far as Duncan was concerned, it was just as possible that Juan could be Tegan's father.
sentences.zh: 在邓肯看来，胡安也有可能是蒂根的父亲。

sentences.en: Police considered this possibility too, but checks with immigration revealed that Juan hadn't even been in Australia at the time of Tegan's conception.
sentences.zh: 警方也考虑过这种可能性，但移民局的核查显示，在蒂根受孕时，胡安甚至不在澳大利亚。

sentences.en: It was calculated that Tegan would have been conceived around November or December of 1995.
sentences.zh: 据推算，蒂根应该是在1995年11月或12月左右受孕的。

sentences.en: Duncan Gillies said he wasn't even in
sentences.zh: 邓肯·吉利斯说他当时甚至不在

sentences.en: Sydney at that time.
sentences.zh: 悉尼。

sentences.en: He'd been out of town for three weeks with some friends and had bank statements to prove it.
sentences.zh: 他和朋友出城了三周，并有银行对账单可以证明这一点。

sentences.en: He insisted he had no idea Kelly was pregnant twice during the course of their relationship, even though they were intimate throughout.
sentences.zh: 他坚称在他们交往期间，他根本不知道凯莉两次怀孕，尽管他们一直保持着亲密关系。

sentences.en: As far as Duncan knew,
sentences.zh: 在邓肯看来，

sentences.en: Kelly had been taking the contraceptive pill the whole time they were together.
sentences.zh: 凯莉在他们在一起的整个过程中一直在服用避孕药。

sentences.en: By the start of 2004, it had been several months since police had any contact with Kelly.
sentences.zh: 到2004年初，警方已经有几个月没有与凯莉联系了。

sentences.en: They'd been busy behind the scenes, cross-checking her stories, making discreet inquiries with her friends, and searching for the elusive Andrew Norris.
sentences.zh: 他们在幕后一直很忙，核对她的故事，谨慎地询问她的朋友，并寻找难以捉摸的安德鲁·诺里斯。

sentences.en: The more they discovered, the more convinced they became that Kelly was covering up something major.
sentences.zh: 他们发现得越多，就越确信凯莉在掩盖什么重大事件。

sentences.en: On Thursday, January 8, 2004, Kelly was summoned back to Manly Police Station for her third formal interview regarding Teagan's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 2004年1月8日星期四，凯莉被传唤回曼利警察局，就蒂根的下落进行第三次正式访谈。

sentences.en: By this time, she was busy planning her wedding, which was set to take place the following month.
sentences.zh: 此时，她正忙于筹备婚礼，婚礼定于下个月举行。

sentences.en: Kelly grew visibly upset upon learning that the police had contacted her friends, despite her insistence that none knew anything about the matter.
sentences.zh: 当得知警方联系了她的朋友时，凯莉明显变得不安，尽管她坚称没人知道这件事。

sentences.en: Her fiancé knew nothing about it either and she was worried about what might happen if he found out
sentences.zh: 她的未婚夫对此也一无所知，她很担心如果他发现了会发生什么。

sentences.en: Exasperated, Kelly said her biggest fear was that if the issue went to court her young daughter would be taken away from her
sentences.zh: 凯莉愤愤不平地说，她最担心的是如果这件事闹上法庭，她年幼的女儿会被带走。

sentences.en: and if her parents found out, they'd never speak to her again
sentences.zh: 而且如果她父母知道了，他们就再也不会跟她说话了。

sentences.en: Kelly again insisted Duncan Gillies was not Teagan's father
sentences.zh: 凯莉再次坚称邓肯·吉利斯不是蒂根的父亲。

sentences.en: She said she'd only listed him as such on the hospital paperwork so that he'd be there if something bad happened to her.
sentences.zh: 她说她只是在医院的文件上把他的名字写上去，这样万一她出了什么事，他能在场。

sentences.en: She was adamant.
sentences.zh: 她态度非常坚决。

sentences.en: The father was Andrew Norris.
sentences.zh: 孩子的父亲是安德鲁·诺里斯。

sentences.en: Kelly claimed that she'd only found out about the pregnancy at around the 12-week mark and she didn't tell Andrew about it until a couple of weeks later.
sentences.zh: 凯莉声称她直到怀孕约12周时才发现，而且直到几周后才告诉安德鲁。

sentences.en: Kelly explained,
sentences.zh: 凯莉解释道：

sentences.en: He was very rude and aggressive.
sentences.zh: 他非常粗鲁且具有攻击性。

sentences.en: He said that I'd trapped him and that I was a slut.
sentences.zh: 他说我设局陷害他，还骂我是荡妇。

sentences.en: She said she didn't have any contact with Andrew again until Tegan was born, at which point he, Mel and his mother came to visit them in hospital.
sentences.zh: 她说在蒂根出生前她再没和安德鲁联系过，直到蒂根出生时，他和梅尔以及他的母亲一起来医院看望她们。

sentences.en: Prior to that, they hadn't discussed anything about what would happen with Tegan.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，他们从未讨论过蒂根出生后该怎么办。

sentences.en: It was only then that Andrew and Mel offered to take her.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，安德鲁和梅尔才提出要领养她。

sentences.en: Police wondered what Kelly had intended to do with Tegan if Andrew hadn't shown up and made such an offer.
sentences.zh: 警方想知道，如果安德鲁没有出现并提出这样的建议，凯莉原本打算怎么处理蒂根。

sentences.en: She'd told no one else in her life that she was pregnant and hadn't made any alternative arrangements for Tegan, such as adoption or foster care.
sentences.zh: 她没有告诉生活中的任何人她怀孕了，也没有为蒂根做任何其他的安排，比如领养或寄养。

sentences.en: She hadn't bought any supplies indicating she intended to bring a baby home either, such as a cot, car seat, clothes or nappies.
sentences.zh: 她也没有购买任何表明她打算把孩子带回家的用品，比如婴儿床、安全座椅、衣服或尿布。

sentences.en: In her first police interview, Kelly said that after handing Tegan over to Andrew, he drove her to Duncan's place In her second, she said she caught a taxi
sentences.zh: 在第一次接受警方讯问时，凯莉说在把蒂根交给安德鲁后，他开车送她去了邓肯家；在第二次讯问时，她说她是打车去的。

sentences.en: This time, Kelly told the detectives that she drove herself home in her own car
sentences.zh: 这一次，凯莉告诉侦探，她是自己开车回家的。

sentences.en: Years earlier, she'd told police she'd celebrated Andrew's 30th birthday at the Town Hall Hotel in August 1996
sentences.zh: 多年前，她曾告诉警方，她在1996年8月在市政厅酒店庆祝了安德鲁的30岁生日。

sentences.en: She now claimed she had no contact with him during that time.
sentences.zh: 她现在声称在那段时间里她与他没有任何联系。

sentences.en: Kelly was warned that if Tegan couldn't be located, a coronial inquest would be necessary, at which point the story would no doubt leak out.
sentences.zh: 凯莉被警告说，如果找不到蒂根，就必须进行死因裁判官调查，到那时这件事无疑会泄露出去。

sentences.en: After more than two hours of questioning, the detective told Kelly,
sentences.zh: 在超过两个小时的审讯后，侦探对凯莉说：

sentences.en: I find it hard to believe the story you've given me.
sentences.zh: 我很难相信你给我的这个说法。

sentences.en: If there's anything that you wish to tell me now before we stop the interview, if there's something you've been holding back from me, I urge you now to tell me.
sentences.zh: 如果在我们结束审讯前你还有什么想告诉我的，如果你有什么一直瞒着我的，我强烈要求你现在说出来。

sentences.en: Kelly replied,
sentences.zh: 凯莉回答道：

sentences.en: I don't have anything more to say.
sentences.zh: 我没什么可说的了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Kelly Lane stuck to her story about giving Tegan to Andrew Norris, hired a solicitor, and refused to speak to the police again.
sentences.zh: 凯莉·莱恩坚持她关于把蒂根交给安德鲁·诺里斯的说法，聘请了一名律师，并拒绝再次与警方交谈。

sentences.en: A tap was placed on her phone.
sentences.zh: 她的电话被安装了窃听器。

sentences.en: In one call to a friend, Kelly shared her fear of having her secret pregnancies become public knowledge.
sentences.zh: 在给朋友的一通电话中，凯莉分享了她对秘密怀孕之事公之于众的恐惧。

sentences.en: It's gonna blow wide open, Kelly said.
sentences.zh: “一切都要彻底曝光了，”凯莉说。

sentences.en: My parents are going to be so embarrassed and ashamed.
sentences.zh: “我的父母会感到非常尴尬和羞愧。”

sentences.en: An audibly upset Kelly confided that she was terrified of losing her daughter Emily as a consequence, stating, I used to worry so much about wanting to be a sports star and
sentences.zh: 凯莉在电话里听起来很不安，她吐露说自己非常害怕因此失去女儿艾米丽，并说道：“我过去总是很担心，想成为一名体育明星，

sentences.en: achieving these wonderful things, but the only thing I'm really good at is being a mum.
sentences.zh: 取得这些了不起的成就，但我真正擅长的只有做一名母亲。”

sentences.en: Kelly's parents and fiancé were finally made aware of the situation, but they stuck by Kelly, refusing to provide formal police statements.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的父母和未婚夫最终得知了情况，但他们支持凯莉，拒绝提供正式的警方证词。

sentences.en: Although the covert recordings failed to capture anything incriminating, investigators felt it was time for the case to go before the coroner.
sentences.zh: 尽管秘密录音没能捕捉到任何有罪的证据，但调查人员认为案件是时候提交给死因裁判官了。

sentences.en: The purpose of holding a coronial inquest wasn't necessarily to find out if Kelly had done something to harm Tegan.
sentences.zh: 举行死因裁判调查的目的并不一定是为了查明凯莉是否对蒂根做了什么伤害行为。

sentences.en: It was to determine whether Tegan was still alive.
sentences.zh: 而是为了确定蒂根是否还活着。

sentences.en: By putting Kelly and those closest to her on the stand, they hoped that something might be revealed that exposed the truth.
sentences.zh: 通过让凯莉和她身边最亲近的人出庭作证，他们希望能够揭露真相。

sentences.en: The inquest commenced before a closed court in mid-2004.
sentences.zh: 调查于2004年中期在闭门法庭开始。

sentences.en: Due to the sensitive subject matter, a media suppression order was put in place, preventing journalists from reporting on the story.
sentences.zh: 由于主题敏感，法庭下达了媒体禁令，禁止记者报道此事。

sentences.en: As the proceedings got underway, the hunt for Tegan Lane continued.
sentences.zh: 随着诉讼程序的进行，对蒂根·莱恩的搜寻仍在继续。

sentences.en: Birth and death registries for every Australian state and territory were checked for anyone who could possibly be the missing child.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚每个州和领地的出生和死亡登记处都进行了核查，寻找任何可能是这个失踪孩子的人。

sentences.en: Working on the possibility that the wrong date of birth could have been entered, investigators widened their search to any girls born between April 1996 and September 1997.
sentences.zh: 基于出生日期可能填错的可能性，调查人员将搜索范围扩大到1996年4月至1997年9月之间出生的所有女孩。

sentences.en: They eventually came up with a list of 12,000 individuals, but investigations into each ruled them out as being Tegan Lane
sentences.zh: 他们最终列出了一份12,000人的名单，但对每个人的调查都排除了她们是蒂根·莱恩的可能性。

sentences.en: Casting a wider net, memos were sent to every public and private school across the country, as well as all homeschooling bodies
sentences.zh: 为了撒下更大的网，他们向全国所有的公立和私立学校以及所有在家教育机构发送了备忘录。

sentences.en: Authorities were seeking any female child born on September 12, 1996 with a father named Andrew Norris, Andrew Morris, or a father whose name wasn't listed
sentences.zh: 当局正在寻找任何出生于1996年9月12日的女性儿童，其父亲名为安德鲁·诺里斯、安德鲁·莫里斯，或父亲姓名未列出。

sentences.en: Checks were made with the Department of Immigration to see if anyone had applied for a passport for a baby girl between September and December 1996 who could possibly be Tegan Lane
sentences.zh: 他们还向移民局进行了核查，看是否有人在1996年9月至12月期间为一名女婴申请过护照，而该女婴可能是蒂根·莱恩。

sentences.en: No such child was identified
sentences.zh: 没有发现这样的孩子。

sentences.en: Checks with government authorities confirmed that no babies had been anonymously abandoned in New South Wales in 1996
sentences.zh: 政府当局的核查证实，1996年新南威尔士州没有婴儿被匿名遗弃。

sentences.en: Neither did any morgues have any remains that could be a potential match to Teagan
sentences.zh: 太平间也没有任何遗骸可以与蒂根匹配。

sentences.en: By October 2004, it had been eight years since Teagan's birth and five years since the issue of her whereabouts first came to the attention of the police
sentences.zh: 到2004年10月，距离蒂根出生已经过去了八年，距离她下落不明的问题首次引起警方注意也已经过去了五年。

sentences.en: Given how much time had passed, the coroner felt they no longer had any choice.
sentences.zh: 考虑到已经过去了这么久，死因裁判官觉得他们别无选择。

sentences.en: While he wanted to respect Kelly's privacy, he also felt it was time to turn to the general public for information.
sentences.zh: 虽然他想尊重凯莉的隐私，但也觉得是时候向公众寻求信息了。

sentences.en: As later revealed by the ABC, the coroner offered Kelly a deal.
sentences.zh: 正如后来澳大利亚广播公司（ABC）所披露的那样，死因裁判官向凯莉提出了一个交易。

sentences.en: If she came clean and told them where Tegan was, he'd give her immunity.
sentences.zh: 如果她坦白交代蒂根在哪里，他就给她豁免权。

sentences.en: Otherwise, he had no choice but to make a public appeal.
sentences.zh: 否则，他别无选择，只能公开呼吁。

sentences.en: While it hasn't been confirmed what exactly he promised to give her immunity from, the coroner clarified that the offer didn't extend to potential murder charges.
sentences.zh: 虽然他承诺给予她何种豁免权尚未得到证实，但死因裁判官澄清说，该提议不包括潜在的谋杀指控。

sentences.en: Kelly and her lawyers were given 10 minutes to discuss their options.
sentences.zh: 凯莉和她的律师有10分钟的时间来讨论他们的选择。

sentences.en: They rejected the offer.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝了该提议。

sentences.en: Kelly's lawyer told the court,
sentences.zh: 凯莉的律师告诉法庭：

sentences.en: There is nothing further Kelly can add at this point in time.
sentences.zh: “凯莉目前没有什么可以补充的了。”

sentences.en: Both she and her family are very keen to find Tegan, to find her safe and well.
sentences.zh: “她和她的家人都非常渴望找到蒂根，希望她平安无事。”

sentences.en: The media suppression order was subsequently lifted and the case was propelled into the headlines.
sentences.zh: 媒体禁令随后被解除，该案登上了各大头条。

sentences.en: An anonymous tipster soon came forward with a vital detail.
sentences.zh: 一名匿名举报人很快提供了一个关键细节。

sentences.en: It turned out that just hours after leaving the hospital on Saturday September 14, 1996,
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在1996年9月14日星期六离开医院仅几个小时后，

sentences.en: Kelly attended a wedding with the Duncan Gillies.
sentences.zh: 凯莉就和邓肯·吉利斯一起参加了一场婚礼。

sentences.en: The couple getting married were old friends of Duncan's family.
sentences.zh: 结婚的那对夫妇是邓肯家多年的老朋友。

sentences.en: Video footage of the ceremony captured Kelly as she took her seat in the church dressed in a creamy white suit despite giving birth less than 48 hours prior.
sentences.zh: 婚礼的录像捕捉到了凯莉在教堂就座时的样子，她穿着一套奶油白色的套装，尽管她在不到48小时前才刚生完孩子。

sentences.en: At no point did she mention Teagan or what she'd just been through.
sentences.zh: 她自始至终没有提到蒂根，也没有提到她刚刚经历的一切。

sentences.en: When Duncan was questioned about this, he later recalled that he'd been out of town prior to the wedding but returned to Sydney specifically for the event.
sentences.zh: 当邓肯被问及此事时，他后来回忆说，他在婚礼前不在城里，但专门为了参加这次活动回到了悉尼。

sentences.en: He'd met Kelly at her parents' house in Fairlight at around 3pm and they'd travelled to the wedding together.
sentences.zh: 他在下午3点左右在费尔莱特的凯莉父母家见到了她，然后他们一起前往婚礼现场。

sentences.en: If this was true, with Kelly and Tegan leaving the hospital at around midday, it meant there was roughly a three-hour window of time unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，考虑到凯莉和蒂根在中午左右离开医院，这意味着大约有三个小时的时间无法解释。

sentences.en: Auburn Hospital was about an hour's drive from the Lane's house, maybe more depending on traffic.
sentences.zh: 奥本医院距离莱恩家大约有一小时的车程，视交通情况而定，可能更久。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered what Kelly was doing for those other two hours between leaving the hospital and arriving at her parents' place, babyless and ready to attend the wedding.
sentences.zh: 调查人员想知道，在离开医院和到达她父母家之间，凯莉在那剩下的两个小时里在做什么，当时她身边没有孩子，正准备去参加婚礼。
