sentences.en: While the investigation continued, the public hearing for the inquest commenced in June 2005.
sentences.zh: 在调查继续的同时，死因裁判调查的公开听证会于2005年6月开始。

sentences.en: The most intimate details of Kelly Lane's private life became daily fodder for reporters, with readers enthralled by the prospect of an accomplished
sentences.zh: 凯莉·莱恩私生活中最隐秘的细节成了记者们每天的素材，读者们被一个成就卓著的年轻女性的前景所吸引，

sentences.en: young woman with a close-knit family, a wide circle of friends, a long-term boyfriend, and various sporting coaches, successfully concealing three pregnancies without anyone
sentences.zh: 她有着关系紧密的家庭、广泛的朋友圈、长期的男友和各种体育教练，却成功地隐瞒了三次怀孕，而没有人

sentences.en: asking a single question.
sentences.zh: 提出过任何疑问。

sentences.en: The public was gripped by the possibility that this seemingly loving mother could have done something to harm her newborn baby, and equally fascinated by the
sentences.zh: 公众被这样一个可能性所吸引：这位看似慈爱的母亲可能对她刚出生的婴儿做了什么伤害行为，同时也对凯莉私生活中

sentences.en: salacious details of Kelly's personal life.
sentences.zh: 那些香艳的细节感到着迷。

sentences.en: Tongues wagged about how she could have become pregnant so many times and who the fathers might be.
sentences.zh: 人们议论纷纷，猜测她怎么会怀孕这么多次，以及孩子的父亲可能是谁。

sentences.en: People wondered why Kelly had gone through with each pregnancy when the secrecy of it all would have been such a heavy burden for a young woman to carry alone.
sentences.zh: 人们想知道，为什么凯莉在明知这一切的保密工作对一个年轻女性来说是如此沉重的负担时，还要坚持完成每一次怀孕。

sentences.en: Reporters gathered outside the courthouse each day of the hearing, snapping photos of those involved as they arrived to reluctantly provide their testimony.
sentences.zh: 记者们每天都聚集在法院外，拍摄那些不情愿地赶来作证的相关人员。

sentences.en: On the stand, Duncan Gillies said that to describe the whole situation as a hell of a shock would be an understatement
sentences.zh: 在证人席上，邓肯·吉利斯说，用“极大的震惊”来形容整个情况都算是轻描淡写了。

sentences.en: Throughout his relationship with Kelly, he'd never once suspected she was cheating on him
sentences.zh: 在他与凯莉的关系中，他从未怀疑过她对他不忠。

sentences.en: Duncan was forced to reveal details about his and Kelly's sex life While Kelly's friends maintained they had no idea about her alleged affair with Andrew Norris
sentences.zh: 邓肯被迫透露了他和凯莉性生活的细节。虽然凯莉的朋友们坚称她们对她与安德鲁·诺里斯所谓的婚外情一无所知，

sentences.en: Those who socialised with Kelly in their early 20s testified that she was not the type of person to have a one-night stand
sentences.zh: 但那些在20多岁时与凯莉有社交往来的人作证说，她不是那种会发生一夜情的人，

sentences.en: or go off with someone else when she was in a committed relationship
sentences.zh: 或者在处于一段忠诚关系时会与别人乱搞。

sentences.en: Little did Kelly's friends know, Duncan had already consented to a DNA test to check against Kelly's first daughter, Kayla
sentences.zh: 凯莉的朋友们不知道的是，邓肯已经同意进行DNA测试，以与凯莉的第一个女儿凯拉进行比对。

sentences.en: Kayla had been conceived at a time when Duncan and Kelly were in a relationship and her adoption papers listed him as the biological father.
sentences.zh: 凯拉是在邓肯和凯莉处于恋爱关系时怀上的，她的领养文件将他列为亲生父亲。

sentences.en: According to the paperwork completed by Kelly,
sentences.zh: 根据凯莉填写的文件，

sentences.en: Duncan fully consented to the adoption.
sentences.zh: 邓肯完全同意了领养。

sentences.en: The DNA results came back.
sentences.zh: DNA结果出来了。

sentences.en: Duncan was not Kayla's father.
sentences.zh: 邓肯不是凯拉的父亲。

sentences.en: Some of Kelly's friends testified to having heard gossip that Kelly was pregnant back in 1996, but Manley's rumour mill could be toxic
sentences.zh: 凯莉的一些朋友作证说，早在1996年就听到过凯莉怀孕的流言，但曼利的流言蜚语可能是有毒的，

sentences.en: and they didn't think there was any truth to it.
sentences.zh: 她们认为那不是真的。

sentences.en: Yes, Kelly's weight could fluctuate, but she was also a strongly built athletic girl who always wore loose-fitting clothing.
sentences.zh: 是的，凯莉的体重确实会波动，但她也是一个身材健壮的运动型女孩，总是穿着宽松的衣服。

sentences.en: Therefore, they never asked her about it.
sentences.zh: 因此，她们从没问过她。

sentences.en: Even now, with the police investigation in full swing,
sentences.zh: 即使现在，随着警方调查的全面展开，

sentences.en: Kelly's friends said that they hadn't discussed the issue with her.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的朋友们说她们并没有和她讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: Her husband also testified that he hadn't questioned Kelly about Tegan at any great length.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫也作证说，他并没有深入询问过凯莉关于蒂根的事。

sentences.en: Kelly's loved ones had two explanations for their lack of probing.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的亲人们对他们缺乏追问有两个解释。

sentences.en: One, it was clear to them that Kelly didn't want to discuss it.
sentences.zh: 第一，对他们来说很明显，凯莉不想讨论这件事。

sentences.en: Two, she was an excellent mother and a loving, caring person.
sentences.zh: 第二，她是一个出色的母亲，也是一个充满爱心、关心他人的人。

sentences.en: There was no way she would ever harm a child.
sentences.zh: 她绝不可能伤害孩子。

sentences.en: As far as they were all concerned, if Kelly said she gave Tegan to her biological father, then that's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，如果凯莉说她把蒂根交给了亲生父亲，那么事情就是这样发生的。

sentences.en: The social workers, adoption agents and medical staff who had been involved with Kelly over the years also testified.
sentences.zh: 多年来与凯莉有过接触的社会工作者、领养代理人和医务人员也出庭作证。

sentences.en: One confirmed that if Tegan had simply been illegally adopted, the whole issue could be rectified by Kelly signing an adoption consent form.
sentences.zh: 其中一人证实，如果蒂根只是被非法领养了，整个问题可以通过凯莉签署一份领养同意书来纠正。

sentences.en: The coroner therefore made a public appeal asking anyone who may have adopted Tegan to come forward.
sentences.zh: 因此，死因裁判官公开呼吁任何可能领养了蒂根的人站出来。

sentences.en: When this failed to generate a response, the coroner issued a second appeal, asking people to come forward if they knew a childless couple in 1996 who'd suddenly had a baby
sentences.zh: 当这未能产生回应时，死因裁判官发出了第二次呼吁，要求那些在1996年认识一对突然有了孩子的不孕夫妇的人站出来。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, staff at a Queensland primary school roughly 900km away received the memo about Teagan Lane and searched through their database
sentences.zh: 与此同时，大约900公里外昆士兰州一所小学的教职员工收到了关于蒂根·莱恩的备忘录，并在他们的数据库中进行了搜索。

sentences.en: It turned out they had a female student enrolled who was born on September 12, 1996.
sentences.zh: 结果发现他们确实有一名在读的女学生，出生于1996年9月12日。

sentences.en: Her name was Tegan Chapman.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫蒂根·查普曼。

sentences.en: Although her first name was spelt differently to Tegan Lane's, the similarity couldn't be ignored once staff realised her father's name.
sentences.zh: 虽然她的名字拼写与蒂根·莱恩不同，但当工作人员意识到她父亲的名字时，这种相似性就无法忽视了。

sentences.en: Alan Norris.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·诺里斯。

sentences.en: The inquest was put on hold while investigators from New South Wales immediately travelled to Queensland to chase one of the only promising leads in the case to date.
sentences.zh: 调查被暂时搁置，新南威尔士州的调查人员立即前往昆士兰州，去追查该案迄今为止唯一的线索之一。

sentences.en: When Tegan Chapman's mother, Debbie, found out, she insisted police were making a mistake.
sentences.zh: 当蒂根·查普曼的母亲黛比发现后，她坚称警方搞错了。

sentences.en: Debbie's mother also gave a statement saying she'd been present for her granddaughter's birth and there was no way Debbie wasn't the mother.
sentences.zh: 黛比的母亲也发表声明说，她当时在场见证了外孙女的出生，黛比不可能是母亲的说法是不可能的。

sentences.en: But the police weren't willing to take any chances
sentences.zh: 但警方不愿冒险。

sentences.en: They obtained Tegan Chapman's medical records and ran a DNA test against Kelly Lane
sentences.zh: 他们获得了蒂根·查普曼的医疗记录，并与凯莉·莱恩进行了DNA比对。

sentences.en: It wasn't a match
sentences.zh: 结果不匹配。

sentences.en: Up until this point, Kelly's parents had been tight-lipped about the whole situation
sentences.zh: 直到此时，凯莉的父母对整个情况一直守口如瓶。

sentences.en: Robert Lane accompanied his daughter to court each day making it clear to the surrounding press that he intended to stand by Kelly no matter what
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·莱恩每天都陪着女儿去法庭，向周围的媒体明确表示，无论发生什么，他都打算支持凯莉。

sentences.en: But hearing the witness testimony in court was the first time he'd heard the full story about Kelly's three secret pregnancies
sentences.zh: 但听到法庭上的证人证词，是他第一次听到关于凯莉三次秘密怀孕的完整故事。

sentences.en: On the stand, Robert explained that Kelly's weight had always fluctuated depending on what sport she was playing at the time
sentences.zh: 在证人席上，罗伯特解释说，凯莉的体重总是随着她当时参加的运动而波动。

sentences.en: In hindsight, I feel a bit foolish that I didn't notice anything, he said But I had no reason to believe she was pregnant at all
sentences.zh: “事后看来，我对自己什么都没注意到感到有点愚蠢，”他说，“但我根本没有理由相信她怀孕了。”

sentences.en: the lanes weren't particularly religious and both of kelly's parents were aware that she was
sentences.zh: 莱恩一家并不是特别虔诚，凯莉的父母都知道她有性生活。

sentences.en: sexually active the only reason robert could think of for kelly concealing the pregnancies
sentences.zh: 罗伯特能想到的凯莉隐瞒怀孕的唯一原因，

sentences.en: was that she didn't want to disappoint her family she was held in very very high esteem in the
sentences.zh: 是她不想让家人失望。她在家里受到非常非常高的评价，

sentences.en: family robert said she was very very well known in the community i believe she was trying to hide this episode in her life from everyone because of those pressures.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特说，她在社区里也非常非常出名。我相信她是想因为这些压力，向所有人隐瞒她生活中的这段插曲。

sentences.en: Like Kelly's friends and husband, Robert said that after finding out about the investigation, he didn't feel the need to ask Kelly any questions about Tegan's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 像凯莉的朋友和丈夫一样，罗伯特说在得知调查后，他觉得没必要问凯莉关于蒂根下落的任何问题。

sentences.en: While he agreed that Kelly's story about Andrew
sentences.zh: 虽然他同意凯莉关于安德鲁·诺里斯的说法很不寻常，

sentences.en: Norris was unusual, he accepted it unequivocally.
sentences.zh: 但他毫无保留地接受了。

sentences.en: If anything, he thought the man Kelly had an affair with had likely used a fake name.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么的话，他认为凯莉有婚外情的那个男人很可能用了假名。

sentences.en: The only time Kelly's mother, Sandra Lane, attended court was when it was her turn to provide testimony.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的母亲桑德拉·莱恩唯一一次出庭是在轮到她提供证词的时候。

sentences.en: Sandra described her relationship with
sentences.zh: 桑德拉描述她与

sentences.en: Kelly as very good.
sentences.zh: 凯莉的关系非常好。

sentences.en: She didn't think she'd been strict with Kelly while she was growing up and believed they had an open and honest relationship.
sentences.zh: 她认为自己在凯莉成长过程中并不严厉，并相信她们有着开放和诚实的关系。

sentences.en: Sandra firmly denied having any knowledge of Kelly's three secret pregnancies.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉坚决否认对凯莉的三次秘密怀孕有任何了解。

sentences.en: She said if she had known, she would have supported her.
sentences.zh: 她说如果她知道的话，她会支持她的。

sentences.en: Sandra couldn't think of any reason why Kelly hadn't told her about them.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉想不出凯莉为什么没有告诉她这些事。

sentences.en: Like the others, she admitted she hadn't asked Kelly much about it since the truth came to light.
sentences.zh: 和其他人一样，她承认自从真相大白后，她并没有问过凯莉太多关于这件事的情况。

sentences.en: Sandra described the whole situation as incredibly distressing and said it didn't feel appropriate to have an in-depth conversation with Kelly about it.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉形容整个情况令人难以置信地痛苦，并说与凯莉进行深入交谈似乎并不合适。

sentences.en: Sandra had a clear memory of Saturday September 14 1996, the day Kelly was discharged from hospital after giving birth to
sentences.zh: 桑德拉对1996年9月14日星期六有清晰的记忆，那是凯莉在生下蒂根后出院的日子，

sentences.en: Teagan.
sentences.zh: 蒂根。

sentences.en: She recalled that at around 3pm Kelly had arrived home alone to get ready for the wedding.
sentences.zh: 她回忆说，下午3点左右，凯莉独自回到家，准备去参加婚礼。

sentences.en: Duncan was already dressed and waiting for her.
sentences.zh: 邓肯已经穿戴整齐，在等她了。

sentences.en: Kelly showered and dressed, then Sandra dropped them at the wedding.
sentences.zh: 凯莉洗漱更衣后，桑德拉开车送他们去了婚礼现场。

sentences.en: At no point did she recall anything unusual about Kelly's behaviour.
sentences.zh: 她完全不记得凯莉的行为有什么异常之处。

sentences.en: Anticipation was high on Monday June 27, 2005, as Kelly was expected to take the stand.
sentences.zh: 2005年6月27日星期一，人们对凯莉即将出庭作证充满期待。

sentences.en: But just before she was about to do so, the coroner made an announcement.
sentences.zh: 但就在她准备出庭前，验尸官发布了一则公告。

sentences.en: He ordered that the inquest be put on hold while further investigations be conducted into Tegan's possible whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 他下令暂停死因研讯，以便对蒂根可能的下落进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: Requests were made for any CCTV footage from Auburn Hospital during Kelly and Teagan's stay there to be tracked down.
sentences.zh: 相关部门要求搜寻凯莉和蒂根在奥本医院期间的所有监控录像。

sentences.en: Knowing that Kelly had likely driven herself home after being discharged from hospital, he also wanted more time for the car to be forensically examined.
sentences.zh: 由于凯莉在出院后很可能是自己开车回家的，他还希望有更多时间对车辆进行法医鉴定。

sentences.en: By the time the inquest resumed in February 2006, it had been officially running for 15 months.
sentences.zh: 到2006年2月研讯恢复时，该案已正式进行了15个月。

sentences.en: Nothing further had been uncovered and the search for CCTV footage yielded no results.
sentences.zh: 调查没有任何进展，监控录像的搜寻也一无所获。

sentences.en: The now 32-year-old Kelly finally took the stand.
sentences.zh: 现年32岁的凯莉终于走上了证人席。

sentences.en: The counsel assisting the coroner presented her with their first question.
sentences.zh: 协助验尸官的律师提出了第一个问题。

sentences.en: Can you tell this court what happened to Teagan
sentences.zh: 你能告诉法庭，1996年9月14日下午2点左右，

sentences.en: Lane around 2pm on September 14, 1996, when you left the hospital with her.
sentences.zh: 当你带着蒂根·莱恩离开医院时，发生了什么事吗？

sentences.en: At the advice of her lawyer, Kelly responded firmly,
sentences.zh: 在律师的建议下，凯莉坚定地回答：

sentences.en: I do not wish to answer that question.
sentences.zh: 我不愿回答这个问题。

sentences.en: With that, she was free to go.
sentences.zh: 说完，她便可以离开了。

sentences.en: In summing up the case, the council assisting said there could only be three possible options.
sentences.zh: 在总结陈词时，协助律师表示只有三种可能的情况。

sentences.en: Teagan was either with her natural father, she had been given to a person unknown, or she'd met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 蒂根要么是和她的亲生父亲在一起，要么被送给了某个不知名的人，要么就是遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: This case can be described using a number of adjectives, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，这个案件可以用很多形容词来描述。

sentences.en: Bizarre, fascinating, unusual, unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 离奇、迷人、不同寻常、难以置信。

sentences.en: However, at the end of the day, what happened to Teagan Lane is a question that still has no definite answer.
sentences.zh: 然而，归根结底，蒂根·莱恩的遭遇至今仍没有确切的答案。

sentences.en: Kelly's lawyer acknowledged the many lies his client had told but explained this was because she was embarrassed about her sexual conduct
sentences.zh: 凯莉的律师承认他的当事人撒了很多谎，但解释说这是因为她对自己的性行为感到尴尬，

sentences.en: and her failure to prevent unwanted pregnancies
sentences.zh: 以及她未能阻止意外怀孕。

sentences.en: He claimed her lies only proved she was trying to keep the pregnancy secret from everyone in her life
sentences.zh: 他声称，她的谎言只能证明她试图向生活中的所有人隐瞒怀孕的事实。

sentences.en: Kelly's lawyer stated
sentences.zh: 凯莉的律师陈述道：

sentences.en: There is no evidence capable of establishing beyond reasonable doubt that Tegan is dead and therefore, no evidence capable of establishing any form of homicide.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据能够排除合理怀疑地证明蒂根已经死亡，因此，也没有证据能够证实任何形式的谋杀。

sentences.en: The coroner handed down his findings on Wednesday, February 15, 2006.
sentences.zh: 验尸官于2006年2月15日星期三公布了他的调查结果。

sentences.en: He agreed that there were several factors supporting the possibility that Tegan Lane was still alive.
sentences.zh: 他同意有几个因素支持蒂根·莱恩仍然活着的可能性。

sentences.en: Firstly, there was no forensic evidence to suggest otherwise.
sentences.zh: 首先，没有任何法医证据表明情况并非如此。

sentences.en: Secondly, the fact that Kelly placed her first and third children for adoption
sentences.zh: 其次，凯莉将她的第一个和第三个孩子送人领养的事实，

sentences.en: Supported the possibility that she'd also done so with Tegan
sentences.zh: 支持了她也这样对待蒂根的可能性。

sentences.en: Thirdly, it was possible that Tegan's birth was registered under a fake name And she was living under an assumed identity
sentences.zh: 第三，蒂根的出生登记可能使用了假名，她正以假身份生活。

sentences.en: However, the coroner did not accept Kelly's story about giving Tegan to a man named Andrew Norris
sentences.zh: 然而，验尸官并不接受凯莉关于将蒂根交给一个名叫安德鲁·诺里斯的男人的说法，

sentences.en: and he said that without Kelly testifying he was completely unable to accept her final version of events.
sentences.zh: 并表示由于凯莉拒绝作证，他完全无法接受她最终的陈述版本。

sentences.en: The coroner stated, I find it inherently unlikely that a man with whom she was having an
sentences.zh: 验尸官指出：我从本质上认为，一个与她有染的男人，

sentences.en: affair already had a partner, who initially at least was incredibly angry on learning she was pregnant, nevertheless was happy to take the child.
sentences.zh: 已经有了伴侣，且对方在得知她怀孕时起初非常愤怒，却依然乐意收养这个孩子，这在本质上是不太可能的。

sentences.en: He therefore concluded,
sentences.zh: 因此他总结道：

sentences.en: I am comfortably satisfied that Tegan Lane is in fact deceased.
sentences.zh: 我完全确信蒂根·莱恩实际上已经死亡。

sentences.en: While he couldn't say how or where she had died, he was confident it had happened in the days immediately following her birth,
sentences.zh: 虽然他无法说明她是如何或在哪里死亡的，但他确信这发生在孩子出生后的几天内，

sentences.en: and stated, I am disturbed at the possibility that Tegan may have met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 并表示：蒂根可能遭遇不测，这让我感到不安。

sentences.en: His final recommendation was that the case be handed to the New South Wales Homicide Squad for a full review and further investigation.
sentences.zh: 他最后的建议是将此案移交给新南威尔士州凶杀案调查组进行全面审查和进一步调查。

sentences.en: Kelly Lane sobbed uncontrollably in her father's arms as the courtroom erupted in a state of frenzy.
sentences.zh: 当法庭陷入一片混乱时，凯莉·莱恩在父亲怀里失声痛哭。

sentences.en: While the inquest's purpose had been to find answers, it only raised more questions.
sentences.zh: 虽然研讯的目的是为了寻找答案，但它反而引发了更多的问题。

sentences.en: For those in attendance, it was clear that the matter was far from over.
sentences.zh: 对于在场的人来说，很明显这件事远未结束。

sentences.en: If anything, it was just the beginning to be continued.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么的话，那这仅仅是个开始，未完待续。
